entries.title: Fix the license announced in the banner
entries.summary: The license text displayed in the EasyCrypt startup banner was corrected.

entries.title: move cost axioms in abstract theories (fix #175)
entries.summary: Cost axioms were moved into abstract theories, affecting how cost information is declared across several core and crypto theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving cost annotations or complexity reasoning in theories like Bool, List, DBool, DInterval, or DiffieHellman break, check that the required cost axioms are now instantiated via the relevant abstract theory rather than declared inline.

entries.title: Reject `x <- RHS` when `RHS` is a procedure call
entries.summary: The typechecker now rejects the syntax `x <- RHS` when `RHS` is a procedure call (requiring `x <@ RHS` instead).
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script fails with a typing error on an assignment, check whether `x <- f(...)` should be rewritten as `x <@ f(...)` when `f` is a procedure call.

entries.title: Improve parser for anonymous proc parameters
entries.summary: The parser for anonymous procedure parameters was improved, affecting how module/procedure parameter syntax is parsed and typed.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving anonymous procedure parameters or module expressions fail to parse or type-check, review the parameter syntax for compatibility with the updated parser.

entries.title: [env]: fully head-norm the type before fetching its top-level decl.
entries.summary: The environment lookup now fully head-normalizes a type before fetching its top-level declaration.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof that previously worked on a type alias or opaque type now fails during type-class or operator resolution, this internal normalization change may be the cause; try unfolding type definitions explicitly.

entries.title: [reduction]: in cbv, fix handling of stack arguments
entries.summary: A bug in the call-by-value reduction engine's handling of stack arguments was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof relying on cbv reduction or `cbv` simplification now behaves differently, this fix may have changed the normal form; try re-examining the reduced term.

entries.title: error message if cost information are missing in the call tactic
entries.summary: The `call` tactic now emits a proper error message when cost information is missing instead of failing silently.
entries.repair_hint: If the `call` tactic now raises an error about missing cost information, supply the required cost annotations or use a variant of `call` that does not require them.

entries.title: Fix typing of modules expressions
entries.summary: A bug in the typing of module expressions was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving module expressions previously accepted now fails to type-check, or vice versa, this typing fix may be the cause; review module type annotations.

entries.title: [reduction]: use symmetric "and" when reducing tuples equality
entries.summary: The call-by-value reduction engine was changed to use a symmetric `and` when reducing tuple equalities, affecting how such goals are normalized.
entries.repair_hint: If goals involving tuple equality are no longer automatically reduced or if their normal form has changed, adjust rewriting steps or `simplify` calls accordingly.

entries.title: pretty printer improvements for module restrs + local memtypes
entries.summary: Pretty-printer output for module restrictions and local memory types was improved.

entries.title: Remove superflous renamings fixes #146
entries.summary: Superfluous renamings in the `BitWord` abstract theory were removed.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using names from `BitWord` break with 'unknown lemma/operator', check whether the name was one of the removed aliases and use the canonical name instead.

entries.title: [tactic]: [proc*]: fix procedure's arguments substitution
entries.summary: A bug in the `proc*` tactic's substitution of procedure arguments was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `proc*` now fail or produce different subgoals, the argument substitution behaviour has changed; re-examine the goals generated after `proc*`.

entries.title: [chore] update theories/dune
entries.summary: The `theories/dune` build file was updated.

entries.title: [tactic]: [rewrite]: support for multi-rules
entries.summary: The `rewrite` tactic was extended to support multiple rewrite rules in a single invocation.
entries.repair_hint: If a `rewrite` call with multiple rules now behaves differently or is newly accepted, verify that the order and combination of rules still produces the expected goal.

entries.title: License change: CeCILL B/C -> MIT
entries.summary: The EasyCrypt source license was changed from CeCILL B/C to MIT.

entries.title: dopt: extend subdistribution to lossless distributions on options
entries.summary: Extended the dopt theory to support lifting subdistributions to lossless distributions on option types.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving option-type distributions or dopt fail, check whether new lemmas in Distr.ec or SDist.ec now provide direct support that can replace manual reasoning.

entries.title: [tactic]: in `apply... in...`, check that all variables are instantiated
entries.summary: The `apply ... in ...` tactic now checks that all variables are fully instantiated before proceeding.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using `apply ... in ...` now fails with an instantiation error, ensure all variables in the applied lemma are explicitly provided or unifiable from context.

entries.title: [build]: [dune]: auto-generation of theories/dune
entries.summary: Build system updated to auto-generate the theories/dune file via a script.

entries.title: New logic to upper-bound the worst-case complexity of programs
entries.summary: New logic (choare/cost) added to EasyCrypt to upper-bound worst-case program complexity, with widespread changes to core modules and examples.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving program logics or module types break, check whether new cost-related constructs or changed module signatures in ecCoreModules or ecModules affect existing proof scripts.

entries.title: Add lemmas divzMr and divzMl; strenghten and prove modz_pow2_div.
entries.summary: Added lemmas divzMr and divzMl to IntDiv, and strengthened and proved modz_pow2_div.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about integer division or modular arithmetic fail, check whether divzMr, divzMl, or modz_pow2_div can now close goals that previously required manual steps.

entries.title: changed name of lemma
entries.summary: A lemma in Distr.ec was renamed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof referencing a lemma in Distr.ec breaks with a 'not found' error, the lemma may have been renamed; search Distr.ec for a lemma with a similar statement.

entries.title: added stronger version of dmap1E_can
entries.summary: A stronger version of the dmap1E_can lemma was added to Distr.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about dmap and cancellation properties of distributions are failing, try using the new stronger variant of dmap1E_can.

entries.title: Extend standard library (IntDiv) with core results.
entries.summary: Extended the IntDiv standard library with additional core results on integer division.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about integer division fail or become unprovable, check whether newly added results in IntDiv.ec can close the goals directly.

entries.title: Added definition and lemmas for 'put' operator in List.ec.
entries.summary: Added the definition and associated lemmas for the 'put' operator in List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about list element replacement fail, check whether the new 'put' operator and its lemmas in List.ec match the intended semantics.

entries.title: An axiom-free formalization of well-founded relations, induction and recursion.
entries.summary: Added an axiom-free formalization of well-founded relations, induction, and recursion in a new WF.ec theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs requiring well-founded induction or recursion previously relied on axioms, they may now be replaceable with the axiom-free WF theory.

entries.title: Generalize `LorR` theory
entries.summary: The LorR theory was generalized, potentially changing its interface and affecting dependent theories like PKE.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing LorR or PKE break, check whether the generalized LorR theory requires updated instantiation or different assumptions.

entries.title: Stdlib: more results on integer division & exponentiation
entries.summary: Added more results on integer division and exponentiation to the IntDiv standard library.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about integer division or exponentiation fail, check whether newly added lemmas in IntDiv.ec can directly close the goals.

entries.title: Removed redundant "rec" in function declaration.
entries.summary: Removed a redundant 'rec' keyword in an internal function declaration in ecReduction.ml.

entries.title: Partially fix memory capture in substitutions
entries.summary: Partially fixed a bug where memory variables could be incorrectly captured during substitutions in formulas.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving substitution under binders or memory-aware formulas behave differently, this fix may have corrected or exposed subtle capture issues; re-check goals that rely on substitution steps.

entries.title: Lemma stating equality of word and list distributions
entries.summary: Added a lemma to Word.eca stating the equality of word and list distributions.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs connecting word distributions to list distributions fail, check whether the new lemma in Word.eca can close the goal directly.

entries.title: Unfold non-transparent operators in `case` & `elim`.
entries.summary: The `case` and `elim` tactics now unfold non-transparent operators before proceeding.
entries.repair_hint: If `case` or `elim` now succeeds where it previously failed (or vice versa), check whether non-transparent operators in the goal are being unfolded automatically; you may need to adjust manual unfolding steps around these tactics.

entries.title: Fails gracefully when applying a tactic on a completed proof.
entries.summary: Applying a tactic on an already-completed proof now fails gracefully instead of crashing.

entries.title: Get rid of dune-site
entries.summary: The dune-site dependency was removed from the build system.

entries.title: Add rdirs option in config file
entries.summary: An `rdirs` option was added to the EasyCrypt configuration file for specifying additional resource directories.

entries.title: Apply suggestions from code review
entries.summary: Minor code review suggestions were applied to the SDist theory.

entries.title: fix theories
entries.summary: Various theory files were fixed to correct errors or inconsistencies.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs depending on SDist, DDH_hybrid, Indist, or PKE_hybrid break, check for updated lemma statements or interfaces in those theories.

entries.title: allow zero queries in Hybrid and SDist
entries.summary: The Hybrid and SDist theories were updated to allow zero queries.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using Hybrid or SDist fail, check whether assumptions or lemmas about the number of queries have changed to accommodate the zero-query case.

entries.title: lemmas on FSet, List, and DList
entries.summary: New lemmas were added to the FSet, List, and DList theories.

entries.title: First pass: slices are inclusive
entries.summary: Array/sequence slice notation was changed so that slices are inclusive on both ends.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using slice expressions break, check that slice bounds are adjusted for the new inclusive semantics.

entries.title: some lemmas on subseq, fmap, and drat
entries.summary: New lemmas on subsequences, fmap, and drat were added to List, Distr, and SmtMap theories.

entries.title: add lemma RO_LRO and generalize RO_FinRO_D
entries.summary: Lemma `RO_LRO` was added and `RO_FinRO_D` was generalized in the PROM theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `RO_FinRO_D` break, check whether its statement or hypotheses have changed due to the generalization.

entries.title: Fix bug that prevents `rewrite //= in h` to simplify in `h`
entries.summary: Fixed a bug where `rewrite //= in h` failed to simplify the hypothesis `h`.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof previously worked around this bug with explicit simplification steps on hypotheses after `rewrite //=`, those workarounds may now be redundant or cause issues.

entries.title: lift LRO oracle out of FullEager
entries.summary: The LRO oracle was lifted out of the FullEager functor in the PROM/ROM theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using FullEager, LRO, or related ROM/PROM interfaces break, check for changes in the module structure and update functor applications or abstract module references accordingly.

entries.title: fix substitution of modules when cloning.
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in module substitution during theory cloning.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving `clone` with module substitutions were previously broken or producing wrong results, re-check them; previously incorrect behavior may now be corrected.

entries.title: PROM: add a ROmap interface for RO + access to the internal map
entries.summary: A `ROmap` interface providing access to the internal map of a random oracle was added to the PROM theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using PROM interfaces break, check whether the new ROmap interface changes the module type or functor signatures you are relying on.

entries.title: [dune] add abstract theories to install list
entries.summary: Abstract theories were added to the dune install list so they are properly installed.

entries.title: Prototype implementation of a match statement.
entries.summary: A prototype match statement was added to EasyCrypt, touching the parser, type-checker, and PHL tactics.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs break due to parsing or type-checking errors around pattern matching constructs, this new match statement syntax may conflict with existing code; check for keyword or construct clashes.

entries.title: New format for eco (v3)
entries.summary: The .eco cache file format was updated to version 3.
entries.repair_hint: If EasyCrypt refuses to load existing .eco cache files, delete them and let them be regenerated.

entries.title: foo
entries.summary: Miscellaneous internal changes to the eco module and scope handling (commit message 'foo').

entries.title: Add an option to define opaque operators
entries.summary: An option was added to declare operators as opaque.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that unfold operators fail, check whether those operators are now declared opaque and use the appropriate unfolding tactic or remove the opaque annotation.

entries.title: New command: locate [partial-qualid]
entries.summary: A new 'locate' command was added to look up partially-qualified identifiers in the environment.

entries.title: remove debugging code
entries.summary: Debugging code was removed from the main EasyCrypt entry point.

entries.title: [build] use dune to install & find resources
entries.summary: The build system was migrated to dune for installation and resource discovery.

entries.title: [SmtMap] add has, find and some lemmas
entries.summary: The SmtMap theory gained 'has' and 'find' operations along with associated lemmas.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about SmtMap now have name conflicts or can be closed with newly available lemmas, update tactic calls to use the new 'has'/'find' lemmas in SmtMap.

entries.title: Remove EcFortune
entries.summary: The EcFortune module was removed from EasyCrypt.

entries.title: disable warning as errors
entries.summary: Compiler warnings were temporarily downgraded from errors in the dune build configuration.

entries.title: remove deprecated functions and reenable warning 3
entries.summary: Deprecated OCaml functions were removed and warning 3 was re-enabled in the build.

entries.title: reenable warning 39
entries.summary: OCaml compiler warning 39 (unused functor parameter) was re-enabled and resulting issues fixed.

entries.title: reenable warning 38
entries.summary: OCaml compiler warning 38 was re-enabled and resulting issues fixed.

entries.title: reenable warning 35
entries.summary: OCaml compiler warning 35 was re-enabled and resulting issues fixed.

entries.title: reenable warning 34
entries.summary: Re-enabled OCaml compiler warning 34 and fixed the resulting unused module warnings across several source files.

entries.title: reenable warning 6
entries.summary: Re-enabled OCaml compiler warning 6 and fixed the resulting label-omission warnings across several source files.

entries.title: [build] use dune in Makefile
entries.summary: Switched the EasyCrypt build system to use dune via the Makefile.

entries.title: [build] do not create an internal EC library
entries.summary: Removed the internal EasyCrypt library from the dune build configuration.

entries.title: [build] Add basic dune support
entries.summary: Added initial dune build support to the EasyCrypt project.

entries.title: renamings: dletE[_swap] -> dlet_muE[_swap] and dletE_mu -> dletE
entries.summary: Renamed distribution lemmas: dletE and dletE_swap became dlet_muE and dlet_muE_swap, and dletE_mu was renamed to dletE.
entries.repair_hint: Replace uses of dletE with dlet_muE, dletE_swap with dlet_muE_swap, and dletE_mu with dletE in proof scripts.

entries.title: adapt to consistent use of mu1
entries.summary: Updated distribution theories (DBool, DProd, Dfilter, SDist) to consistently use mu1 instead of prior naming conventions.
entries.repair_hint: Check for lemma names or expressions in distribution theories that used older mu-related identifiers and replace them with mu1-based equivalents.

entries.title: use mu1 instead of mass in in Distr
entries.summary: Replaced uses of 'mass' with 'mu1' throughout the Distr theory.
entries.repair_hint: Replace occurrences of 'mass' with 'mu1' in proofs that import or use the Distr theory.

entries.title: Refactor & generalize the section mechanism
entries.summary: Refactored and generalized the section mechanism in EasyCrypt, affecting many source and example files.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using sections fail, review section variable declarations and axiom abstractions for compatibility with the new generalized section handling.

entries.title: Fix the pretty printing of \ as a binop
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of the backslash operator when used as a binary operator.

entries.title: comments, renaming, proof*
entries.summary: Added comments, performed renamings, and updated proofs in the SDist theory.
entries.repair_hint: Check for renamed lemmas in SDist.ec if proofs depending on that theory break.

entries.title: allow sdist-distinguishers for ROs to call sample and set
entries.summary: Extended the SDist theory so that statistical-distance distinguishers for random oracles may call 'sample' and 'set' procedures.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about RO-based SDist distinguishers fail, check whether they need to account for the newly permitted 'sample' and 'set' calls in the distinguisher interface.

entries.title: some more simplifications
entries.summary: Applied further simplifications to proofs and definitions in the SDist theory.

entries.title: remove weight equality side conditions
entries.summary: Removed weight-equality side conditions from lemmas in RealSeries and SDist theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs previously discharged a weight-equality side condition from RealSeries or SDist lemmas, remove those now-unnecessary proof obligations.

entries.title: implement feedback from review
entries.summary: Incorporated review feedback into the Number, RealFLub, Distr, and SDist theories with various fixes and clean-ups.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs over these theories break, check for small changes in lemma statements or names introduced by the review-driven clean-up.

entries.title: fix compilation
entries.summary: Fixed a compilation error in the Distr theory.

entries.title: move lemmas from SDist to RealSeries and Distr, rename summableM
entries.summary: Moved lemmas from SDist to RealSeries and Distr, and renamed summableM.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using summableM or lemmas previously in SDist breaks, search for the lemma in RealSeries or Distr and check for the new name of summableM.

entries.title: use PROM rather than ROM
entries.summary: Changed SDist to use PROM (Programmable ROM) instead of ROM.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving SDist and ROM-based oracles break, update them to use PROM instead of ROM.

entries.title: sdist for ROM distinguishers and N distinct queries
entries.summary: Added statistical distance results for ROM distinguishers with N distinct queries.

entries.title: reduction from N to 1 oracle call for sdist distinguisher
entries.summary: Added a reduction from N oracle calls to 1 oracle call for the sdist distinguisher.

entries.title: sdist distinguisher for single oracle call + reduction to single sampling
entries.summary: Added sdist distinguisher for a single oracle call and a reduction to single sampling.

entries.title: connection between sdist and distinguisher procedures
entries.summary: Added lemmas connecting sdist and distinguisher procedures, with changes to DList.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs in DList or SDist break, check for new or changed lemmas relating sdist to distinguisher procedures.

entries.title: statitical distance and some lemmas
entries.summary: Added initial statistical distance definition and associated lemmas in SDist.

entries.title: Add a simple form of pattern selection in rewrite rules
entries.summary: Added a simple form of pattern selection in rewrite rules.
entries.repair_hint: If rewrite tactics behave unexpectedly, check whether pattern-selection syntax is needed or conflicting with the new feature.

entries.title: change "smt in rewrite" syntax
entries.summary: Changed the syntax for using SMT inside rewrite tactics.
entries.repair_hint: If 'rewrite ... smt' usage fails to parse or behaves differently, update the syntax to match the new 'smt in rewrite' format as changed in the parser.

entries.title: Compute free program variables in *hoare statements.
entries.summary: Implemented computation of free program variables in Hoare statements.

entries.title: Implement "gen have" & "wlog suff"
entries.summary: Implemented the 'gen have' and 'wlog suff' tactics.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs use 'gen have' or 'wlog suff', these are newly available tactics; if a proof fails near these tactics, ensure the correct syntax for the new implementation is used.

entries.title: StdLib: summability of partitioning
entries.summary: Added lemmas about summability of partitioning to RealSeries.

entries.title: Some lemmas for floor and ceil, in particular letting one rewrite floor x and ceil x.
entries.summary: Added lemmas for floor and ceil, including rewrite lemmas for floor x and ceil x.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about floor or ceil fail, check whether the new rewrite lemmas in FloorCeil can be applied instead.

entries.title: Added disjoint xs ys as an abbreviation for xs `&` ys = fset0. Added
entries.summary: Added 'disjoint xs ys' as an abbreviation for xs `&` ys = fset0 in FSet.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about set disjointness break or can be simplified, check for the new 'disjoint' abbreviation in FSet.

entries.title: Fix global positions reporting
entries.summary: Fixed reporting of global positions in the lexer and parser.

entries.title: remove duplicate eq_in_count/eq_count_in, keep eq_in_count
entries.summary: Removed the duplicate lemma `eq_count_in` from List.ec, keeping only `eq_in_count`.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses `eq_count_in`, replace it with `eq_in_count`.

entries.title: improve error msg for proc
entries.summary: Improved error messages for the `proc` tactic without changing its behavior.

entries.title: Fix: cleanup exact hint DB after clone
entries.summary: Fixed a bug where the exact-hint database was not cleaned up after a clone.

entries.title: [stdlib] Array: fix set_set_swap
entries.summary: Fixed (corrected the statement or proof of) `set_set_swap` in the Array standard library.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof relies on `set_set_swap` from Array.ec, check that the lemma statement still matches what you expect, as it may have been corrected.

entries.title: Extend cloning with
entries.summary: Extended the `clone ... with` mechanism with additional cloning capabilities, touching many algebra and stdlib theories.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof or theory using `clone ... with` breaks, check whether the new cloning syntax or semantics requires updating substitution clauses or type instantiations.

entries.title: Some nits in the new SmtMap lemmas
entries.summary: Made minor corrections (nits) to newly added lemmas in SmtMap.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using SmtMap lemmas break, check whether lemma names or statements were slightly adjusted.

entries.title: FinType.FinType → FinType
entries.summary: Renamed the inner module/theory `FinType.FinType` to just `FinType` across the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: Replace any occurrence of `FinType.FinType` with `FinType` in proof scripts and theory imports.

entries.title: Shift some results to SmtMap
entries.summary: Moved some results from SplitRO into SmtMap.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If lemmas previously found in SplitRO are missing, look for them in SmtMap instead.

entries.title: Library work towards soft-merge of ChaCha-Poly
entries.summary: Added and reorganized library lemmas across several theories in preparation for merging ChaCha-Poly.
entries.repair_hint: If lemmas in FinType, SmtMap, DList, Word, or related theories are missing or renamed, check whether they were moved or added in this reorganization.

entries.title: 'Cleanup' but it's mostly shifting things around
entries.summary: Refactored and reorganized content in the Hybrid, Indist, and PKE_hybrid encryption theories without semantic changes.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing Hybrid, Indist, or PKE_hybrid break, check whether lemma locations have shifted between files.

entries.title: StdLib: funi + same weight => eq
entries.summary: Added lemma(s) to Distr.ec stating that functions that are uniform injections with the same weight are equal.

entries.title: StdLib: use bigops in generic Hybrid
entries.summary: Refactored the generic Hybrid library to use bigops, updating related encryption theories accordingly.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs in Hybrid, Means, or PKE_hybrid break, check whether the bigop-based reformulations change lemma names or require bigop-aware reasoning.

entries.title: StdLib: basic facts on distributions
entries.summary: Added basic distribution facts to DList.ec and ZModP.ec.

entries.title: Fix bug in theory renamings
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in theory renaming during theory replay.
entries.repair_hint: If theories that use renaming during cloning or replay previously failed or produced wrong names, this fix may resolve the issue.

entries.title: StdLib: ZModP: finite + uniform distribution
entries.summary: Added finite and uniform distribution results to the ZModP theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about distributions over Z/pZ fail, check whether new lemmas in ZModP now provide direct support that previously required manual steps.

entries.title: StdLib: linking sampling in Z/pZ and Z/qZ when q|p
entries.summary: Added lemmas linking sampling in Z/pZ and Z/qZ when q divides p.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs relating interval distributions modulo related moduli fail, look for new linking lemmas in DInterval.

entries.title: StdLib: Poly: killing last admits
entries.summary: Removed remaining admit placeholders in the Poly theory by replacing them with proper proofs.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that relied on admitted lemmas in Poly now fail, the underlying lemma may now have stricter hypotheses or a different statement.

entries.title: StdLib: polynomials distributions
entries.summary: Added distribution-related lemmas and constructions for polynomials in the Poly theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about polynomial distributions fail, check whether newly added lemmas in Poly can close goals that previously required manual argument.

entries.title: StdLib: lead coeff. and degree of X^n+1
entries.summary: Added lemmas about the leading coefficient and degree of the polynomial X^n+1.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving the degree or leading coefficient of X^n+1 fail, look for the newly added lemmas in Poly.

entries.title: StdLib: ring quotient for non-integral domains
entries.summary: Added ring quotient constructions and results for non-integral domains in the Ideal theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about ring quotients or ideals fail, check whether new or changed definitions in Ideal affect the algebraic hierarchy assumptions.

entries.title: StdLib: ring regular element + poly over non integral domains
entries.summary: Added the notion of ring regular elements and extended polynomial results to non-integral domains across multiple algebra theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs in Ring, Poly, or related algebra theories fail, check whether the introduction of regular elements changed typeclass or instance resolution, or whether lemma statements now require a regularity hypothesis.

entries.title: StdLib: more results on pmin
entries.summary: Added further results about the pmin (minimal-element) predicate in IntMin.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving pmin fail, check for new lemmas in IntMin that may now discharge goals automatically or require updated invocations.

entries.title: StdLib: few lemmas about polynomials
entries.summary: Added several small lemmas about polynomials to the Poly theory.
entries.repair_hint: If polynomial proofs fail or become unexpectedly easy, check whether new lemmas in Poly alter automation or name resolution.

entries.title: Fix stdlib
entries.summary: Fixed a broken state in the Hybrid encryption theory in the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing Hybrid fail to compile, ensure your file is compatible with the corrected Hybrid theory.

entries.title: StdLib: enumerating polynomials of a given degree
entries.summary: Added lemmas and constructions for enumerating polynomials of a given degree in the Poly theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about finite sets of polynomials of bounded degree fail, look for new enumeration lemmas added to Poly.

entries.title: StdLib: Finite: explicit witnesses for finitness + related lemmas on lists
entries.summary: Added explicit witness constructions for finiteness and related list lemmas to the Finite theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about finite types or explicit enumeration witnesses fail, check whether the new lemmas in Finite change how finiteness witnesses are constructed or named.

entries.title: Stdlib: IntDiv - add a few lemmas
entries.summary: Added several lemmas about integer division to the IntDiv theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving integer divisibility or modular arithmetic fail, look for newly added lemmas in IntDiv that may now be needed or may conflict with local names.

entries.title: Stdlib: more results on polynomials & ring ideals
entries.summary: Added further results on polynomials and ring ideals across the Ideal and Poly theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about polynomial ideals or ring quotients fail, check for new or changed lemmas in both Ideal and Poly.

entries.title: Prove that polynomials form an integral domain
entries.summary: Proved that the polynomial ring over an integral domain is itself an integral domain.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that invoke integral-domain properties on polynomial types fail, check whether instance resolution now automatically picks up the new integral-domain instance for Poly.

entries.title: Include ring quotients th. in ideals th.
entries.summary: Ring quotient theory was included into the ideals theory in Ideal.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs rely on Ideal.ec, new ring quotient lemmas are now available there; check for name conflicts or new required imports.

entries.title: Stdlib: ring quotients
entries.summary: Ring quotient constructions were added to the standard library in Ideal.ec and Quotient.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs import Ideal.ec or Quotient.ec, new ring-quotient definitions may interact with existing names; check for ambiguity or clashes.

entries.title: Stdlib: fmin
entries.summary: An fmin (finite minimum) definition or theory was added to IntMin.ec in the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that previously defined their own fmin may now clash with the stdlib version; check for name conflicts in IntMin.

entries.title: Quotient: use std def. of eqv relation
entries.summary: Quotient.ec was updated to use the standard library definition of equivalence relations instead of a local one.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that instantiate or clone Quotient.ec may need to supply the stdlib equivalence-relation interface rather than a custom one.

entries.title: Stdlib: simplify proofs in Quotient.ec
entries.summary: Proofs in Quotient.ec were simplified without changing the stated lemmas.

entries.title: Stdlib: ideas & a bit of abstract arithmetic
entries.summary: Ideal theory and some abstract arithmetic lemmas were added to Ideal.ec in the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs importing Ideal.ec may encounter new definitions; check for name conflicts with locally defined ideal or arithmetic notions.

entries.title: List: fix admitted proofs
entries.summary: Previously admitted proofs in List.ec were replaced with complete proofs.

entries.title: List: size_eq1
entries.summary: The lemma size_eq1 was added to List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script defines its own size_eq1 locally, it may now conflict with the stdlib version; rename the local lemma or use the stdlib one.

entries.title: Move to Why3 1.4
entries.summary: EasyCrypt was updated to require Why3 version 1.4.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT/Why3 calls in proof scripts stop working, ensure Why3 1.4 is installed; older Why3 versions are no longer supported.

entries.title: Stdlib: refactoring
entries.summary: Internal refactoring was done in RealExp.ec and Real.ec without adding new results.

entries.title: Stdlib: integer log.
entries.summary: Integer logarithm definitions and lemmas were added to RealExp.ec and Real.ec.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that define their own integer logarithm may now clash with the stdlib version; check for name conflicts in RealExp or Real.

entries.title: List: alltuples & allsubtuples
entries.summary: The alltuples and allsubtuples functions were added to List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that locally define alltuples or allsubtuples may clash with the new stdlib versions; check for naming conflicts.

entries.title: List: subseqs
entries.summary: A subseqs function (enumerating subsequences) was added to List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof defines its own subseqs, it may conflict with the new stdlib definition; check for name clashes in List.

entries.title: Finite types pred + finfun.
entries.summary: Finite-type predicate and finfun definitions were added to Finite.ec.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that import Finite.ec should check for name conflicts with newly added finfun or finite-predicate identifiers.

entries.title: Add a -no-eco option to disable .eco generation
entries.summary: A new -no-eco command-line option was added to disable generation of .eco cache files.

entries.title: Proper goal for conseq equiv hoare => hoare.
entries.summary: The conseq tactic now generates a proper goal when converting an equiv judgment to a Hoare judgment.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using `conseq` to go from equiv/hoare to hoare is failing, check whether the generated subgoals have changed shape and update the proof accordingly.

entries.title: fix translation to why3 for operator, where some of its type parameters do not appear in the its type.
entries.summary: Fixed the translation of operators to Why3 when some type parameters do not appear in the operator's type, also touching Logic.ec and Pervasive.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls involving polymorphic operators were previously failing or producing wrong results, this fix may change SMT behaviour; re-run affected goals.

entries.title: Removing dead code.
entries.summary: Dead code was removed from ecLowGoal.ml.

entries.title: remove debugging informations
entries.summary: Debugging output was removed from ecLowGoal.ml.

entries.title: tactic/if: do not eagerly simplfy the pre
entries.summary: The `if` tactic no longer eagerly simplifies the precondition.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using the `if` (or `case`) tactic on conditionals in PHL/PHLC start failing, the precondition is no longer pre-simplified; add an explicit simplification step after `if` if needed.

entries.title: refactoring proofs
entries.summary: Internal proof scripts in List.ec, DBool.ec, and FinType.eca were refactored without changing statements.

entries.title: more lemma on dbfun
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about dbfun were added to DBool.ec.

entries.title: add lemma dfun_ll
entries.summary: The lemma dfun_ll was added to Distr.ec.

entries.title: stdlib: eager biased sampling
entries.summary: Eager biased sampling results were added to the standard library in DBool.ec and related files.

entries.title: stdlib: more results on dfun
entries.summary: Additional results about dfun (distribution of functions) were added to Distr.ec and List.ec.

entries.title: stdlib: gen. def. of distr. of functions
entries.summary: A general definition for distributions of functions was added to Distr.ec and List.ec.

entries.title: Lib: uniform distributions over finite functions
entries.summary: Uniform distributions over finite functions were added to Distr.ec.

entries.title: Losslessness axioms are now added to the "rnd" database
entries.summary: Losslessness axioms are now automatically registered in the `rnd` hint database when declared.
entries.repair_hint: If `rnd` tactics that previously required manual losslessness hints now succeed automatically, or if previously passing proofs break due to changed automation, check whether explicit losslessness hints are still needed.

entries.title: Renaming: XXX_full -> XXX_fu
entries.summary: Lemmas named XXX_full in Matrix.eca were renamed to XXX_fu.
entries.repair_hint: Replace any use of lemma names ending in `_full` from Matrix.eca with the corresponding `_fu` names.

entries.title: printing added lemma by operator declaration
entries.summary: Added printing of lemmas that are automatically generated by operator declarations.

entries.title: Basic results on dvector/dmatrix
entries.summary: Added basic results on dvector and dmatrix distributions to Matrix and Distr theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about dvector or dmatrix distributions are failing, check whether newly added lemmas in Matrix.eca or Distr.ec can close the goal directly.

entries.title: Basic results on dvector/dmatrix
entries.summary: Added additional basic results on dvector and dmatrix to Matrix and List theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about dvector or dmatrix are failing, check whether newly added lemmas in Matrix.eca or List.ec apply.

entries.title: More results on dlet/dmap
entries.summary: Added more lemmas about dlet and dmap to the Distr theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving dlet or dmap fail, check whether new lemmas in Distr.ec can be used to close the goal.

entries.title: Axiomatized operators are now forcibly unfoldable
entries.summary: Axiomatized operators are now always treated as unfoldable during reduction.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving axiomatized operators now reduce differently or unexpectedly, or conversely if a proof that previously required manual unfolding now fails, this change to reduction behavior for axiomatized operators is the likely cause.

entries.title: t_subst not in the trusted base + some improvement to />.
entries.summary: Removed t_subst from the trusted base and improved the '/>' tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using 'subst' or '/>' (slash-greater) tactics fail, the changed behavior of t_subst or the improved '/>' tactic may be the cause; try adjusting the proof steps that rely on substitution or '/>' simplification.

entries.title: pragma -oldip become the default
entries.summary: The '-oldip' pragma behavior became the default, affecting how inductive proofs are processed.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that previously required the '-oldip' pragma now behave differently or proofs that relied on the old default behavior break, this change in default induction/instance processing is the likely cause; try adding or removing the pragma explicitly.

entries.title: fix quadratic behavior of ecCallbyValue
entries.summary: Fixed a quadratic performance regression in the call-by-value evaluator.

entries.title: remove deprecated "cut" tactic
entries.summary: The deprecated 'cut' tactic has been removed from EasyCrypt.
entries.repair_hint: Replace any use of the 'cut' tactic with 'have' in proof scripts, as 'cut' is no longer recognized.

entries.title: implement -R flag
entries.summary: Implemented the -R command-line flag for EasyCrypt.

entries.title: `apply` is now using product-compatible matching
entries.summary: The 'apply' tactic now uses product-compatible matching, allowing it to match through product types.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using 'apply' now succeed where they previously failed, or fail in new ways due to unexpected matching through products, adjust the apply calls accordingly; the new matching may resolve or introduce unification issues.

entries.title: remove debug infos
entries.summary: Removed debug information from the phl consequence rule implementation.

entries.title: small refactoring
entries.summary: Small internal refactoring of the reduction module.

entries.title: add trivial lemma
entries.summary: Added a trivial lemma to the Distr theory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about distributions is failing with a trivial goal, check whether the newly added lemma in Distr.ec closes it.

entries.title: stack based conversion
entries.summary: Replaced the conversion/reduction engine with a stack-based implementation.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that rely on definitional equality or unification now fail or succeed differently, the new stack-based conversion engine may be changing reduction behavior; try adding explicit rewriting steps or unfolding.

entries.title: Decimal numbers are now translated to irreducible fractions
entries.summary: Decimal number literals are now automatically converted to irreducible fractions in the internal representation.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving decimal literals (e.g. 0.5, 1.25) breaks, check whether the new irreducible-fraction representation changes how terms are displayed or matched; rewrite lemmas or hints referencing decimal forms may need updating.

entries.title: In pose/trivial: use less conversion, cleanup chain of trivial calls.
entries.summary: The `pose` and `trivial` tactics were changed to use less conversion, and the internal chain of `trivial` calls was cleaned up.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs relying on `trivial` or `pose` to close goals via conversion now fail, try adding explicit `simplify` or `rewrite` steps to expose the required equalities before calling `trivial`.

entries.title: make congr less costly
entries.summary: The `congr` tactic was made less computationally costly by internal optimizations.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `congr` break, the tactic may now be slightly less powerful in what it solves automatically; try adding intermediate steps or `simplify` calls.

entries.title: simplify t_split
entries.summary: The internal implementation of `t_split` was simplified without changing its user-facing behaviour.

entries.title: fix cbv user_red
entries.summary: A bug in the call-by-value reduction with user-defined reductions (`cbv user_red`) was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `cbv` with user reduction rules were previously failing or giving wrong results, they may now succeed; conversely, proofs that accidentally relied on the buggy behaviour may need updating.

entries.title: simplify user reduction
entries.summary: The user-reduction mechanism was simplified, affecting the parser and the reduction engine.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using user-defined reduction rules (e.g. via `cbv`) break, check whether the syntax for specifying reductions has changed and update accordingly.

entries.title: Core theory for univariate polynomials
entries.summary: A core theory for univariate polynomials (`Poly.eca`) was added to the algebra library.

entries.title: Stdlib: more results on Rn + bigops on Rn
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about real numbers and big operators over reals were added to several standard-library theories.

entries.title: Small addititions on distributions
entries.summary: Small additions (new lemmas) were made to the distributions theory `Distr.ec`.

entries.title: More results on distributions (conditional exp, Jensen (finite))
entries.summary: New results on distributions including conditional expectation and Jensen's inequality (finite case) were added.

entries.title: integrating more results on distributions
entries.summary: Additional results on distributions were integrated into the standard library.

entries.title: small generalization of PRP
entries.summary: The PRP (pseudorandom permutation) theory was slightly generalized.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs cloning or using `PRP.eca` or `Birthday.ec` break, check whether the generalized interfaces require additional parameters or assumptions.

entries.title: extend conseq rules: equivF => hoareF => hoareF and equivF => phoareF => phoareF
entries.summary: The `conseq` tactic was extended with new rules allowing `equivF` to imply `hoareF` and `phoareF` judgements.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs using `conseq` to derive Hoare or pHoare goals from equivalence judgements may now succeed where they previously failed; if existing proofs break, check whether the new rule application changes the generated subgoals.

entries.title: basic results about minr
entries.summary: Basic lemmas about `minr` were added to the `Number` theory.

entries.title: Fix "smt debug"
entries.summary: A bug in the `smt debug` diagnostic mode was fixed.

entries.title: Fix bug in conseq
entries.summary: A bug in the conseq tactic was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using conseq was failing or behaving unexpectedly, this fix may restore correct behavior; try re-running conseq steps.

entries.title: New option for SMT: "debug"
entries.summary: A new 'debug' option was added to the SMT invocation configuration.

entries.title: Fix dfold s.t. the functor takes the index
entries.summary: The dfold operator was fixed so that its functor argument receives the current index.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs using dfold may break if they relied on the old signature where the functor did not take an index; update functor arguments accordingly.

entries.title: New operator: dfold
entries.summary: A new operator dfold was added to the Distr theory.

entries.title: "={_}" now supports the construction "glob M \ { p1, p2, ... }"
entries.summary: The ={_} equality syntax now supports the glob exclusion form 'glob M \ { p1, p2, ... }'.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses glob equality with exclusions, check that the new syntax is used correctly; old scripts not using this feature should be unaffected.

entries.title: better printing of modules bodies w.r.t. "import var"
entries.summary: Improved pretty-printing of module bodies with respect to 'import var' declarations.

entries.title: The command "import var" is now allowed at top-level
entries.summary: The 'import var' command is now permitted at the top level, not only inside modules.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses 'import var' at top level and previously failed to parse, it should now work; no existing proofs should break.

entries.title: add alias "include var" that stands for "include" then "import var"
entries.summary: A new alias 'include var' was added as shorthand for 'include' followed by 'import var'.

entries.title: "import var" now takes a space-separated list of modules
entries.summary: The 'import var' command was extended to accept a space-separated list of module names.
entries.repair_hint: Existing single-module 'import var' usage should still work; update scripts that need to import multiple modules to use the new list syntax.

entries.title: New command in modules: import var M
entries.summary: A new 'import var M' command was introduced inside module bodies to import a module's variables into scope.

entries.title: Help smt along in brittle proofs
entries.summary: Brittle SMT-backed proofs in RealSeq and Logic theories were made more robust.

entries.title: easycrypt why3config uses --full-config
entries.summary: The easycrypt why3config helper now passes the --full-config flag.

entries.title: First attempt at handling Why3 1.3.X
entries.summary: Initial support for Why3 version 1.3.x was added to the SMT backend.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls are failing after a Why3 upgrade to 1.3.x, this change adds compatibility; ensure the Why3 version matches what EasyCrypt expects.

entries.title: Fix merge problem
entries.summary: A merge conflict in the PROM theory file was resolved.

entries.title: Clean up the ROM libraries
entries.summary: The ROM libraries were cleaned up, affecting multiple files including PROM, ROM, Eager, Lazy, LazyEager, and NewROM.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that depend on the ROM or PROM libraries should be checked for broken imports, renamed lemmas, or changed interfaces after this cleanup.

entries.title: Do no search for rewriting patterns modulo conversion.
entries.summary: Rewriting no longer searches for patterns modulo conversion, requiring more explicit matches.
entries.repair_hint: If a `rewrite` tactic that previously matched a subterm now fails, the pattern may no longer match modulo conversion; try adding explicit type annotations, using `rewrite (expr)` with a more explicit form, or inserting a `change` or `simplify` step first.

entries.title: Theory on square matrices (up to ring structure)
entries.summary: New theory content for square matrices up to ring structure was added to Matrix.eca.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about square matrices fails, check whether newly added lemmas in Matrix.eca can be used directly.

entries.title: Fix compilation
entries.summary: A compilation fix was applied to Ring.ec.

entries.title: in rewrite find occurences using alpha conversion first.
entries.summary: The `rewrite` tactic now finds occurrences using alpha-conversion first when searching for patterns.
entries.repair_hint: If rewriting behavior changed around alpha-equivalent terms, this may explain why a `rewrite` now succeeds or matches differently; try being more explicit about which occurrence to rewrite.

entries.title: add reduction for -i = i'
entries.summary: A reduction rule for negation of integers (`-i = i'`) was added to the core formula machinery.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving integer negation now simplifies differently or automation closes goals it previously could not, this new reduction rule may be responsible.

entries.title: remove duplicate declaration
entries.summary: A duplicate declaration was removed from ecCoreFol.mli.

entries.title: binomial law + basic lemmas (full / support)
entries.summary: Binomial distribution lemmas covering full support were added to Binomial.ec and Distr.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about binomial distributions is missing lemmas, check the new additions in Binomial.ec and Distr.ec.

entries.title: "search" now works with notations
entries.summary: The `search` command was extended to work with notations.

entries.title: smt: do not filter wanted lemma
entries.summary: The `smt` tactic no longer filters out explicitly wanted lemmas.
entries.repair_hint: If an `smt` call now succeeds that previously failed (or vice versa), this change in lemma filtering may be responsible; try adjusting the lemma hints passed to `smt`.

entries.title: Add user reductions for iteri
entries.summary: User-level reductions for `iteri` were added, affecting simplification in several algebra and datatype theories.
entries.repair_hint: If `simplify` or reduction tactics now unfold `iteri` where they previously did not, or if proofs using `iteri` behave differently, these new reductions are likely the cause; try `delta` with explicit names or guard reductions.

entries.title: Refactor & merge min/max & integer/real pow.
entries.summary: The min/max and integer/real power theories were refactored and merged, reorganizing many lemmas across algebra, analysis, and datatype theories.
entries.repair_hint: If lemmas about min, max, integer exponentiation, or real exponentiation are no longer found, they may have been renamed or moved during this refactor; search for equivalent lemmas in Number.ec, Ring.ec, or the merged theory files.

entries.title: Some extra lemmas on Ring.expr
entries.summary: Extra lemmas about `Ring.expr` (ring exponentiation) were added to Ring.ec, Number.ec, and StdOrder.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about ring exponentiation needs additional facts, check the new lemmas added to Ring.ec and Number.ec.

entries.title: add lemmas on bigi
entries.summary: New lemmas about `bigi` (bounded integer big operators) were added to Bigalg.ec and StdBigop.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about `bigi` is missing needed lemmas, check the additions in Bigalg.ec and StdBigop.ec.

entries.title: Allows nosmt with all operators other than pure, abstract ones - i.e., with plain, axiomatized (including : {t | phi} as ax) and cases operators. When cloning, [op nosmt x = ...] is allowed, but nosmt can't be used with inlining mode.
entries.summary: The `nosmt` annotation is now allowed on a broader class of operators (plain, axiomatized, cases) and in clone declarations, but not in inlining mode.
entries.repair_hint: If an operator declaration or clone that previously rejected `nosmt` now accepts it (or vice versa), update the annotation accordingly; also check that `nosmt` is not used with inlining mode.

entries.title: Added two useful lemmas to Quotient.ec
entries.summary: Two new lemmas were added to Quotient.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about quotient structures needs additional facts, check the new lemmas in Quotient.ec.

entries.title: Definition of quotient types w.r.t. a equivalence relation
entries.summary: Added a theory for quotient types with respect to an equivalence relation in Logic.ec and Quotient.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses quotient type constructions, check that the new Quotient theory is required/imported correctly.

entries.title: Finite groups, cyclic groups, Bezout.
entries.summary: Added theories for finite groups, cyclic groups, and Bezout's identity, along with supporting lemmas in algebra and integer libraries.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about groups or modular arithmetic fail, check whether new lemmas in Group.ec, IntDiv.ec, or ZModP.ec conflict with or supersede existing ones.

entries.title: Use arrow-based assignments
entries.summary: Updated examples and theories to use arrow-based assignment syntax throughout the codebase.
entries.repair_hint: If proof scripts use the old assignment syntax, update them to use the arrow-based assignment syntax (e.g., `x <- e` style changes).

entries.title: stdlib: distributions: dmap1E_can
entries.summary: Added lemma `dmap1E_can` to the distributions library.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs a cancellative dmap pointwise equality lemma, try using `dmap1E_can` from Distr.ec.

entries.title: stdlib: List: nth_default
entries.summary: Added lemma `nth_default` to the List library.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about list indexing with default values fails, check whether `nth_default` from List.ec applies.

entries.title: lemma: fun_ext2
entries.summary: Added lemma `fun_ext2` for extensionality of binary functions to Logic.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof requires extensionality for two-argument functions, try applying `fun_ext2`.

entries.title: allow writing m.[i, j] in place of m.[(i, j)]
entries.summary: Added syntactic sugar allowing `m.[i, j]` as an alternative notation for `m.[(i, j)]` in map lookups.
entries.repair_hint: If proof scripts use `m.[(i, j)]` and encounter parse issues, or vice versa with `m.[i, j]`, try the alternate notation.

entries.title: views: allow application of induction principle as a view
entries.summary: Extended the `views` mechanism to allow induction principles to be applied as views.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using a view or `move/` with an induction principle fails, check whether the new capability changes how the induction principle is applied.

entries.title: elim: search quantifier modulo reduction
entries.summary: The `elim` tactic now searches for quantifiers modulo reduction when selecting what to eliminate.
entries.repair_hint: If `elim` now succeeds or fails differently on goals that require unfolding/reduction to expose a quantifier, adjust the proof to pre-reduce or rely on the new behavior.

entries.title: Fixed unclosed box. (#41)
entries.summary: Fixed an unclosed pretty-printing box in the printing module.

entries.title: binomial coefficients
entries.summary: Added a theory for binomial coefficients and supporting lemmas to Ring.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about binomial coefficients fail, check that Binomial.ec is required and use the lemmas provided there.

entries.title: Matching for *hoareF & Pr
entries.summary: Extended the matching engine to handle `hoareF` and `Pr` forms.
entries.repair_hint: If pattern matching or rewriting inside hoare/probability goals now behaves differently, the updated matching for `hoareF` and `Pr` may be the cause.

entries.title: User error message for map-style lvalue on unsupported assignment
entries.summary: Added a user-facing error message for unsupported map-style lvalue assignments.

entries.title: Only accepts Alt-Ergo from version 2.3.1
entries.summary: EasyCrypt now only accepts Alt-Ergo from version 2.3.1 and above.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls via Alt-Ergo start failing, ensure the installed Alt-Ergo version is at least 2.3.1.

entries.title: In `rewrite`, use a keyed matching algorithm for finding occurences.
entries.summary: The `rewrite` tactic now uses a keyed matching algorithm when searching for occurrences to rewrite.
entries.repair_hint: If `rewrite` no longer finds or rewrites expected occurrences, or now rewrites unexpected ones, adjust occurrence selectors or lemma application order to account for the new keyed matching behavior.

entries.title: Allow operators of the form 'n where n is a *fixed* natural number
entries.summary: The lexer and parser were extended to allow operators of the form 'n where n is a fixed natural number.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof fails after this change, check whether operator notation involving natural number literals (e.g., 'n forms) is parsed correctly in the new version.

entries.title: better conversion + simplify reduction algorithm.
entries.summary: The conversion and simplification/reduction algorithms were improved, affecting how goals are reduced during proof search.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof that relied on specific reduction behavior (e.g., simplify, cbv, or automatic conversion) breaks, try adjusting reduction flags or explicitly unfolding definitions that were previously handled automatically.

entries.title: "hint simplify [reduce]" does one head reduction for finding the quantifers
entries.summary: The 'hint simplify [reduce]' directive was changed to perform one head reduction step when searching for quantifiers.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using 'hint simplify' with reduction hints break, the change in how head reduction is applied during quantifier search may require adding explicit reduction steps or adjusting simplification hints.

entries.title: Add new options to 'hint simplify':
entries.summary: New options were added to the 'hint simplify' directive, extending its configuration surface.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using 'hint simplify' break, check whether existing hint declarations need to be updated to use the new option syntax or whether old options are still supported.

entries.title: Consolidate PRP and PRF libraries
entries.summary: The PRP and PRF libraries were consolidated, reorganizing theories and potentially renaming or moving lemmas and modules.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing PRF or PRP theories break, check for renamed or moved modules/lemmas within the consolidated library structure and update require/import statements accordingly.

entries.title: Refactor PlugAndPray
entries.summary: The PlugAndPray theory/module was refactored.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that use or clone PlugAndPray break, check whether the module interface or lemma names have changed after the refactor.

entries.title: Generalize arguments about sampling in dexcepted
entries.summary: Arguments about sampling in dexcepted distributions were generalized, with updates to related theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving dexcepted sampling lemmas break, check whether previously used lemmas have been generalized (changing types or hypotheses) or replaced in Dexcepted, Dice_sampling, or RndExcept.

entries.title: [done] solves context of the form [false |- G]
entries.summary: The 'done' tactic was extended to solve goals of the form [false |- G].
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that previously required an explicit contradiction step to close goals with 'false' in the context may now be closed directly with 'done'.

entries.title: Remove dead code in 't_solve'
entries.summary: Dead code was removed from the internal t_solve tactic implementation.

entries.title: Improve />.
entries.summary: The '/>.' closing tactic was improved, with changes to supporting infrastructure and several standard theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using '/>' or '/>.' to close goals break or behave differently, the improved tactic may handle goals in a different order or require fewer/more steps; try adjusting the proof around those tactic invocations.

entries.title: fix DHIES
entries.summary: A bug fix was applied to the DHIES example theory.

entries.title: fixing examples
entries.summary: Several example files and PrimeField were fixed to work with the current EasyCrypt version.

entries.title: Fix parser
entries.summary: A bug in the lexer/parser was fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If syntax that previously failed to parse now parses (or vice versa), this parser fix may be the cause; check whether the construct in question is accepted by the updated parser.

entries.title: Printers for rewrite & solve databases
entries.summary: Printer support was added for the rewrite and solve hint databases, enabling inspection of their contents.

entries.title: add lemma in "random" database
entries.summary: New lemmas were added to the 'random' hint database in the DList and Distr theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using the 'random' tactic or hint database behave differently (e.g., solve more or fewer goals automatically), it may be due to the newly registered lemmas; check whether automation now handles cases that previously required manual steps.

entries.title: Rename internal tactic t_auto into t_solve
entries.summary: The internal ML-level tactic function t_auto was renamed to t_solve.

entries.title: improve automatic simplification of rnd rule for equiv
entries.summary: Automatic simplification after applying the rnd rule for equiv judgments was improved.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using rnd in an equiv context now closes goals that previously required manual steps, or conversely if new subgoals appear, adjust the proof steps following rnd accordingly.

entries.title: improve t_auto internal tactic
entries.summary: The internal t_auto tactic was improved for better automatic goal solving.

entries.title: automatically remove lossless condition in rnd{i}
entries.summary: The rnd and rndi tactics now automatically discharge lossless side conditions.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script has explicit steps discharging lossless conditions after rnd or rndi, those steps may now be redundant and could cause proof failures; try removing them.

entries.title: add simplification rule for oget_some, oget_none
entries.summary: Simplification rules for oget_some and oget_none were added to the Core theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving oget now simplify further than expected (or goals that previously required manual rewriting close automatically), check that no subsequent steps conflict with the new automatic simplification.

entries.title: Compiles with OCaml 4.07 -> 4.09 (tested)
entries.summary: Compatibility fixes were made to allow EasyCrypt to compile with OCaml 4.07 through 4.09.

entries.title: remove failing SMT
entries.summary: A failing SMT call was removed from the Distr theory.

entries.title: More results on dlet / dprod
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about dlet and dprod were added to the Distr theory.

entries.title: Generate and use .eco files.

entries.title: In `case`, normalized 'glob' when searching for an inductive type.
entries.summary: The `case` tactic now normalizes 'glob' expressions when searching for an inductive type.
entries.repair_hint: If `case` fails or behaves differently on goals involving glob/memory expressions, this normalization change may be the cause; try adjusting the term passed to `case`.

entries.title: Remove debugging infos
entries.summary: Removed debugging information from the core goal module.

entries.title: New option from inline: [tuple].
entries.summary: Added a new `[tuple]` option to the `inline` tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If `inline` now parses differently or has changed behavior around tuple assignments, try adding or removing the `[tuple]` option.

entries.title: Fix handling of abstract theories imports.
entries.summary: Fixed handling of imports from abstract theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving abstract theory clones or imports are broken, this fix to import handling may be relevant; check that abstract theory instantiation still resolves names correctly.

entries.title: This commit introduces two major features.
entries.summary: Introduced two major features affecting the core formula language, reduction, theory replay, and several standard libraries.
entries.repair_hint: This large commit touches core formula representation, reduction, theory replay, and many libraries; if proofs break after this change, check for renamed or restructured lemmas in SmtMap, Distr, Bigalg, or changes in reduction/unification behavior.

entries.title: Solve tactic: apply is now done modulo delta
entries.summary: The `solve` tactic now performs `apply` modulo delta (unfolding definitions).
entries.repair_hint: If `solve` now closes goals it previously could not, or closes goals unexpectedly, this delta-unfolding change is the cause; proofs that worked around `solve` limitations may need adjustment.

entries.title: Misc. in SmtMap.ec
entries.summary: Miscellaneous changes to the SmtMap theory file.
entries.repair_hint: If lemmas in SmtMap have changed names or statements, proofs depending on SmtMap may need updating.

entries.title: Add interleave tactic
entries.summary: Added a new `interleave` tactic for interleaving program statements.
entries.repair_hint: This is a new tactic addition; existing proofs are unlikely to break, but scripts can now use `interleave` for program reordering tasks.

entries.title: Add transitivity * (transivity with generation of VC)
entries.summary: Added `transitivity *` variant that automatically generates verification conditions.
entries.repair_hint: If `transitivity` syntax has changed or existing uses are broken, check whether the new `*` form conflicts with old usage patterns.

entries.title: Pragmas for printing pre/post as a list of their resp. conjunctions
entries.summary: Added pragmas to control printing of pre/post conditions as lists of their conjuncts.
entries.repair_hint: This affects display only and should not break proofs, but if pretty-printing behavior has changed in ways that affect proof state parsing, check pragma settings.

entries.title: Add decimal literals
entries.summary: Added support for decimal literals in EasyCrypt.
entries.repair_hint: If existing numeric literals are now parsed differently, check that integer vs. decimal literal disambiguation has not changed the type or value of constants in your proofs.

entries.title: New intro pattern: [#|].
entries.summary: Added a new intro pattern `[#|]` for splitting conjunctions/disjunctions during introduction.
entries.repair_hint: This is a new intro pattern; existing intro patterns should be unaffected, but if the lexer/parser changes conflict with existing syntax, check intro pattern sequences.

entries.title: refactor flagged map && PROM (#22)
entries.summary: Refactored the flagged map structure and the PROM theory.

entries.title: user error message for FXE_CtorInvalidArity

entries.summary: Added reduction rules for integer division and modulo via `edivz` and bound the corresponding symbol to Why3.

entries.title: Add congruence rule for projections

entries.repair_hint: If `congr` fails on goals involving projections, this addition may now make it succeed; alternatively, proofs that previously worked around missing projection congruence may need adjustment.

entries.title: Extend matching (projections)
entries.summary: Extended the term matching engine to handle record/tuple projections.
entries.repair_hint: If tactics relying on matching (e.g., `rewrite`, `apply`) were failing on goals with projections, they may now succeed; revisit such failures.

entries.title: Bind auto-conseq in eqobsin

entries.title: "call L" automatically applies "L" to "_" when needed.

entries.title: fix reduction of fixpoints with extra arguments
entries.summary: Fixed reduction of fixpoint expressions that have extra arguments beyond the fixpoint's own parameters.

entries.title: Fix pretty printing of records projectors (when applied)

entries.title: add missing quantification over memory in async while

entries.title: fix List.ec

entries.summary: Refined the probability bound in the Strong_RP_RF theory.
