entries.summary: A mistake related to oiter in the parser was corrected.

entries.title: Fixed poor spacing.
entries.summary: Whitespace/spacing issues in the parser were fixed.

entries.title: Reworking specification of current provers.
entries.summary: The specification syntax and handling of the current list of SMT provers was reworked.
entries.repair_hint: If smt calls fail or prover lists are not recognized, check whether the syntax for specifying provers has changed.

entries.title: Added clean way to clear the list of current provers.
entries.summary: A clean way to clear the list of current SMT provers was added.

entries.title: SmtMap: rng and basic results
entries.summary: Range (rng) function and basic results were added to the SmtMap theory.

entries.title: SmtMap : fdom and related results
entries.summary: New lemmas about fdom and related results were added to the SmtMap theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about SmtMap finite domains are failing, check whether the needed fdom lemmas are now available in SmtMap.ec.

entries.title: SMT backed map/fmap
entries.summary: SMT-backed map and fmap support was introduced, affecting CoreMap, NewMap, and SmtMap theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving maps or fmaps break, check whether the underlying SMT encoding changed and whether lemmas from NewMap/SmtMap need to be used instead of or in addition to old map lemmas.

entries.title: FSet library: subset is an operator rather than a predicate
entries.summary: In FSet, subset was changed from a predicate to an operator.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using FSet subset fail, update usage from predicate-style to operator-style (e.g., rewrite/apply patterns may need adjustment).

entries.title: Fix bug in theory-cloning renaming
entries.summary: A bug in theory-cloning renaming was fixed in the theory replay machinery.
entries.repair_hint: If theory cloning with renaming was silently producing wrong results before, proofs that relied on the broken behavior may now fail; review clone renaming maps.

entries.title: New tactical: try!
entries.summary: A new tactical 'try!' was introduced.

entries.title: New tactic: solve
entries.summary: A new tactic 'solve' was added to EasyCrypt.

entries.title: New IP: //> & ||>
entries.summary: New introduction pattern combinators '//>' and '||>' were added.

entries.title: more lemmas on FSet.oflist
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about FSet.oflist were added to the FSet library.

entries.title: New tactic: wlog (without loss of generality).
entries.summary: A new tactic 'wlog' (without loss of generality) was added.

entries.title: Minimal attempt at stabilising Hybrid
entries.summary: Minor stabilization changes were made to the Hybrid encryption theory to make proofs more robust.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using Hybrid.ec break, check whether stabilization changes altered lemma statements or proof structure in that theory.

entries.title: More stabilising smt in ROM
entries.summary: SMT calls in ROM.ec were further stabilized.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing ROM.ec fail with smt, the stabilization changes may have altered the shape of goals expected by smt; try adding or removing hypotheses passed to smt.

entries.title: Stabilise smt in old ROM.ec
entries.summary: SMT calls in the old ROM.ec were stabilized.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing ROM.ec fail with smt, the stabilization changes may have altered the shape of goals expected by smt; try adding or removing hypotheses passed to smt.

entries.title: In ROM.ec, help `smt` by using `move=> />`.
entries.summary: In ROM.ec, 'move=> />' was used to help smt discharge goals more reliably.
entries.repair_hint: If ROM.ec proofs using smt are fragile, try adding 'move=> />' before smt calls to simplify the goal.

entries.title: opsem: generate spec lemmas
entries.summary: The operational semantics module now generates specification lemmas automatically.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs rely on manually stated spec lemmas that are now auto-generated, check for name conflicts or changed statement forms.

entries.title: Internal: do not consider an applied abstract module as a non-functor abstract module
In subst, when crossing a binding, remove the bound variable.
entries.summary: Fixed substitution to correctly remove bound variables when crossing a binding in core formula substitution.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving substitution under binders was previously accepted due to this bug, it may now fail or require adjustment.

entries.title: op: fix creation of refined operators
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in the creation of refined operators in the scope module.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs use refined operators that previously behaved incorrectly, their behavior may change after this fix.

entries.title: Remove references
entries.summary: Removed references (likely mutable reference cells) from core formula and related modules.

entries.title: Fixed glob unsoundess through eager normalization of globs when type checking and substituting modules.
entries.summary: Fixed a glob unsoundness issue by eagerly normalizing globs during type checking and module substitution.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involve module glob expressions that were previously accepted due to unsound glob handling, they may now fail; check glob-related proof steps and module substitutions.

entries.title: stdlib: new lemma on summable
entries.summary: New lemmas on summable sequences were added to the standard library.

entries.title: Read library paths from the EC_IDIRS/EC_RDIRS env. vars.
entries.summary: EasyCrypt now reads library include/require paths from the EC_IDIRS and EC_RDIRS environment variables.

entries.title: add more lemmas on converto
entries.summary: Additional lemmas on convergence (converto) were added to RealSeq.

entries.title: remove hyp in normrV
entries.summary: A hypothesis was removed from the lemma normrV in the Number theory, weakening its preconditions.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof discharges the now-removed hypothesis of normrV, that proof step may fail; remove the corresponding obligation.

entries.title: stdlib: limit of the inverse of a sequence
entries.summary: New lemmas on the limit of the inverse of a sequence were added to RealSeq and Ring.

entries.title: Fix the printing of operator bodies
entries.summary: Fixed the pretty-printing of operator bodies.

entries.title: cloning: fix regression bug in operators convertibilty check
entries.summary: Fixed a regression bug in the operator convertibility check during theory cloning.
entries.repair_hint: If a clone that previously failed due to operator convertibility now succeeds (or vice versa), adjust the clone statement accordingly.

entries.title: Operator unfolding when applied to enough arguments
entries.summary: Operators are now unfolded during reduction when applied to a sufficient number of arguments.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs relying on operators not being unfolded when partially applied may now reduce further than expected; check simplification and reduction steps involving partially applied operators.

entries.title: [runtest]: new CLI argument --bin
entries.summary: A new --bin CLI argument was added to the runtest script.

entries.title: hint simplify now extracts rewriting rules from <=>
entries.summary: The hint simplify mechanism now extracts rewriting rules from iff (<=>), not just equality.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs using hint simplify may now simplify further using iff lemmas; if a proof breaks due to over-simplification or changed normal forms, review which iff lemmas are in the hint database.

entries.title: Fixed the type given to a constructor when matching directly.
entries.summary: Fixed the type assigned to a constructor when pattern matching directly in PHL rule for conditional.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving rcond or direct constructor matching in a conditional was failing due to type errors, this fix may resolve it.

entries.title: Operators body can now be formulas
entries.summary: Operator bodies can now be formulas (not just expressions), extending the operator declaration syntax.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs rely on operators whose bodies are now treated as formulas, reduction or SMT behaviour may differ; check if unfolding or simplification of such operators needs adjustment.

entries.title: get rid of axiom in `Birthday`
entries.summary: An axiom in the Birthday theory was replaced by a proper proof, removing an unproven assumption.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof depended on the removed axiom from Birthday, it may need to be re-examined; the result is now a proved lemma so the interface should be compatible.

entries.title: Additional List lemmas.
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about lists were added to the List and RealSeries theories.
entries.repair_hint: New lemmas are available in List and RealSeries; proofs that previously needed manual steps may now close with existing lemmas.

entries.title: [internal] EcSubst does not rely anymore on the low-level substitutions
entries.summary: Internal refactor: EcSubst no longer relies on low-level substitution infrastructure.

entries.title: fix smt that regressed with z3 bump to 4.12.2
entries.summary: Fixed SMT calls in DBool that regressed after a Z3 bump to version 4.12.2.
entries.repair_hint: If smt calls involving DBool lemmas started failing after a Z3 upgrade, this fix may restore them; try re-running smt on affected goals.

entries.title: Propagate subtype changes to Word
entries.summary: The Word theory was updated to propagate subtype-related changes.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using the Word theory break due to subtype or coercion issues, check whether lemma signatures or operator types have changed.

entries.title: Ring/field tactics available as soon as an instance is found.
entries.summary: The ring and field tactics are now available as soon as a suitable instance is found, without requiring explicit registration.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that previously failed because ring/field tactics were unavailable may now succeed; conversely, if instance search picks up an unexpected instance, tactic behaviour may differ.

entries.title: get rid of unbounded smt calls outside examples
entries.summary: Unbounded smt calls in standard theories (outside examples) were replaced with bounded or more specific proof steps.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs in the affected theories now time out or fail because formerly-used lemmas changed their proof method, try providing explicit hints or increasing smt timeout.

entries.title: Additonal lemmas on fset equality establishing an equivalence, and additional lemma on perm_eq and undup (making the oflist_perm_eq lemma redundant).
entries.summary: Additional lemmas on fset equality and on perm_eq/undup were added, making oflist_perm_eq redundant.
entries.repair_hint: New lemmas are available in FSet and List; if oflist_perm_eq was used, check whether it has been removed or superseded.

entries.title: Fix wording of error messages
entries.summary: Wording of error messages was improved with no semantic changes.

entries.title: [chore] fix more raw smt calls
entries.summary: Raw smt calls in several standard theories were replaced with more explicit proof steps.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs in Ring, ZModP, List, or related theories behave differently, it may be due to changed proof terms underlying these lemmas; re-check any proof that imports these theories.

entries.title: [chore] fix raw smt calls (theories/distributions)
entries.summary: Raw smt calls in distribution-related theories were replaced with explicit proof steps.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs depending on FSet, DList, Distr, or Mu_mem lemmas behave differently, check whether the underlying proof terms changed and whether smt can still close the same goals.

entries.title: [chore] remove more raw smt calls
entries.summary: More raw smt calls in Bigop and crypto theories were removed and replaced with explicit proofs.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing Bigop, DHIES, or Strong_RP_RF break, the change in underlying proof terms may affect automation; try adding explicit lemma hints.

entries.title: [chore] fix some warnings and flaky smt calls (#408)
[theories] define product using allpairs (#411)
entries.summary: The FSet product operation is now defined using allpairs.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about the FSet product operator fail, check whether the new allpairs-based definition changes reduction behaviour or requires different lemmas.

entries.title: Renaming the easycrypt lib (making it easyier for external imports) (#410)
entries.summary: Renamed the EasyCrypt internal library to make it easier for external imports.

entries.title: proc op: add support for the "local" modifier
entries.summary: Added support for the 'local' modifier in the 'proc op' construct.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using 'proc op' fails, try adding or removing the 'local' modifier to match the new syntax.

entries.title: [theories] additional elimination rules for finite sums (#401)
entries.summary: Additional elimination rules for finite sums were added to the RealSeries theory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about finite sums is failing, check whether one of the new elimination lemmas in RealSeries can close the goal.

entries.title: Refactor out Fermat's little theorem from ZModP to IntDiv
entries.summary: Fermat's little theorem was refactored from ZModP into IntDiv, moving relevant lemmas between theories.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof importing Fermat's little theorem from ZModP breaks, look for the relevant lemmas in IntDiv instead.

entries.title: Prove Fermat's little theorem
entries.summary: Fermat's little theorem was proved and added to the ZModP theory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs Fermat's little theorem, it is now available in ZModP.

entries.title: Keep f_let_simp
entries.summary: The f_let_simp function was retained in EcFol after a refactoring.

entries.title: Remove dead code relating to substitution; instead, the f_subst mechanism should be used. (And this is in fact done for simplification of let formulas in EcReduction.)
entries.summary: Dead substitution code was removed from the formula core; f_subst is now the canonical substitution mechanism.

entries.title: New inline tactic
entries.summary: A new version of the inline tactic was introduced with updated syntax and behavior.
entries.repair_hint: If inline tactic invocations fail, check the new syntax in examples/tactics/inline.ec and update tactic calls accordingly.

entries.title: Turned the files in src into a lib called Core. (#397)
entries.summary: Source files in src/ were reorganized into a library called Core.

entries.title: Remove dead code (#398)
entries.summary: Dead code was removed from ecCoreHiPhl.

entries.title: Take PolyReduce theory from Kyber project
entries.summary: The PolyReduce theory was added to the EasyCrypt standard library, taken from the Kyber project.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs polynomial reduction results, the new PolyReduce theory may provide relevant lemmas.

entries.title: restore name
entries.summary: A name in the ROM theory was restored to a previous name.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using the ROM theory has a name-resolution failure, check whether the lemma or definition name was reverted to an older name.

entries.title: Tighten the ROM bad call results
entries.summary: The bad-call bounds/results in the ROM theory were tightened.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof relying on ROM bad-call lemmas fails, check whether the statement of those results changed to be tighter and update the proof accordingly.

entries.title: [lib] FSet: fcard_eq1
entries.summary: The lemma fcard_eq1 was added to the FSet theory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about finite set cardinality is failing, the new fcard_eq1 lemma in FSet may help close the goal.

entries.title: [lib] List: remove all raw smt calls
entries.summary: All raw smt calls in the List theory were replaced with proper proofs.

entries.title: New rewrite-pr lemma: Pr[muE]
entries.summary: A new rewrite lemma for probability of measure expressions (Pr[muE]) was added to the core library and PHL probability rewriting machinery.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving probability rewriting fails, try using the new Pr[muE] rewrite lemma explicitly.

entries.title: properly fail early if one SMT returns `Invalid`
entries.summary: The SMT prover integration now fails early when any SMT solver returns an 'Invalid' result.
entries.repair_hint: If a previously passing smt call now fails immediately, the SMT solver may be returning 'Invalid'; try a different solver or check the goal more carefully.

entries.title: warn on `Invalid` SMT results
entries.summary: The SMT prover integration now emits a warning when an SMT solver returns an 'Invalid' result.

entries.title: [theories]: p_max (maximum probability for atomic events)
entries.summary: Added p_max (maximum probability for atomic events) and supporting lemmas across several theory files.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about maximum probabilities fails, check whether the new p_max definition and associated lemmas in Distr or SDist can be applied.

entries.title: Removed Smart constructors for types, expressions, formulae, paths, and statements.
entries.summary: Smart constructors for types, expressions, formulae, paths, and statements were removed from the core OCaml internals.

entries.title: Forbid the usage of [declare] for concrete modules.
entries.summary: Using the 'declare' keyword for concrete (non-abstract) modules is now forbidden.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses 'declare' on a concrete module, remove 'declare' or convert the module to abstract.

entries.title: Fix datatype comparisons for theory replays
entries.summary: Fixed datatype comparison logic used during theory replays.

entries.title: Accept non-printed variable only abbreviations.
entries.summary: The notation system now accepts abbreviations that bind variables which are not printed.
entries.repair_hint: If a notation or abbreviation involving non-printed variables previously failed to parse, it may now be accepted.

entries.title: New command: proc op. This command generates an operator that computes the output distribution of a stateless proc.
entries.summary: A new 'proc op' command was added that generates an operator computing the output distribution of a stateless procedure.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs to reason about the distribution produced by a stateless procedure, try using the new 'proc op' command to obtain a corresponding operator.

entries.title: [theories] FunRO: RO for FinType using dfun for init
entries.summary: The FunRO random oracle for FinType was updated to use dfun for initialization.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using FunRO or cloning PROM.ec break, check whether the initialization step now relies on dfun and update accordingly.

entries.title: use polymorpic wrapper to enable theory cloning
entries.summary: A polymorphic wrapper was added to Logic.ec and Subtype.eca to enable theory cloning.
entries.repair_hint: If cloning the Subtype theory fails, check that the polymorphic wrapper is applied correctly.

entries.title: clean up SubType theory
entries.summary: The Subtype theory was cleaned up with minor refactoring.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that clone or use Subtype.eca break, review the cleaned-up theory for renamed or removed lemmas.

entries.title: New Subtype theory. Updated stdlib to match.
entries.summary: A new Subtype theory was introduced and the standard library was updated to use it, affecting algebra, encryption, and structure theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using Subtype, ZModP, Quotient, or related algebra/structure theories break, check for renamed or restructured lemmas in the new Subtype theory.

entries.title: Commit b2106aa suppressed additional parentheses around match ... end in all circumstances, even though on the left and right of applications the parser requires parentheses, the theory being this makes it easier for humans to scan. So this commit inserts parentheses around matches in applications, but not elsewhere (e.g., not in infix operators). See below for examples. [The pretty printer needs a major redesign, so this is another stopgap measure.]
entries.summary: The pretty printer was updated to insert parentheses around match expressions when they appear in application position, but not in other positions such as infix operators.
entries.repair_hint: If proof scripts depend on exact printed forms of match expressions (e.g., in pattern matching or rewriting), the changed parenthesization may affect parsing or display; review printed goals and terms.

entries.title: Track the argument variables as well. Also update ROM proof.
entries.summary: Argument variables are now tracked in addition to return variables, and the ROM proof was updated accordingly.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using ROM.eca or related random oracle arguments break, check whether the updated variable tracking changes the shape of goals or available hypotheses.

entries.title: [tactic] Rewrite Equiv
entries.summary: A new 'rewrite equiv' tactic variant was introduced, allowing rewriting using equational equivalences in proof goals.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using 'rewrite' with an equiv lemma fails, check whether the new 'rewrite equiv' syntax is required instead.

entries.title: An attempt at fixing pretty printing bugs in which formulas that end with implications, conditionals or quantifiers and appear to the left of binary operators have their scopes extended to include those following binary operators. E.g.,
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing bugs where formulas ending with implications, conditionals, or quantifiers on the left of binary operators incorrectly extended their scope.
entries.repair_hint: If proof goals involving implications, conditionals, or quantifiers next to binary operators now display differently, this is a display fix and should not break proofs, but may affect how goals are read.

entries.title: simplify some smt calls
entries.summary: Simplified some SMT calls in standard bigop, order, and PRP/PRF theory files.

entries.title: drop unused and obsolete theory files
entries.summary: Removed unused and obsolete theory files OldDistr, OldDistrCheck, and OldFMap from the oldlibs directory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof imports OldDistr, OldDistrCheck, or OldFMap, those files no longer exist and must be replaced with their current equivalents.

entries.title: Extend definition of PKE to ROM from Kyber spec
entries.summary: Extended the PKE theory to include a ROM-based definition following the Kyber specification.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof imports PKE.ec and relies on its structure, check whether the extended ROM definitions conflict with existing instantiations.

entries.title: [theories]: add various individual lemmas
entries.summary: Added various individual lemmas across algebra, analysis, datatype, distribution, and structure theories.
entries.repair_hint: New lemmas are available in Bigalg, RealSeries, Int, List, DBool, SDist, and Finite; proofs that previously required manual steps may now close with these lemmas.

entries.title: [theories]: port "lock" from MathComp
entries.summary: Ported the 'lock' definition/lemma from MathComp into the Logic theory.
entries.repair_hint: The 'lock' construct is now available in Logic.ec; proofs needing to protect a definition from unfolding can use it.

entries.title: [theories]: finite expectation (Jensen_fin_concave)
entries.summary: Added a finite expectation / Jensen's inequality for concave functions (Jensen_fin_concave) to the Distr theory.
entries.repair_hint: The lemma Jensen_fin_concave is now available in Distr.ec for proofs involving finite expectations.

entries.title: [theories]: lemmas for dcond and dbiased
entries.summary: Added new lemmas about dcond and dbiased distributions to DBool and Distr theories.
entries.repair_hint: New lemmas for dcond and dbiased are available; proofs about conditional or biased Boolean distributions may now have shorter derivations.

entries.title: [dune]: auto-generate the list of EC files to be installed
entries.summary: Updated the build system (dune) to auto-generate the list of EasyCrypt theory files to be installed.

entries.title: matrix library with support for arbitrary dynamic size (#267)
entries.summary: Added a new dynamic-size matrix library (DynMatrix) along with supporting changes to Bigalg and Number.
entries.repair_hint: The DynMatrix theory is now available; proofs involving matrices with arbitrary dynamic sizes can import it.

entries.title: Fix encoding of Why3 fixpoint containing higher-order calls to itself
entries.summary: Fixed the Why3/SMT encoding of fixpoint definitions that contain higher-order recursive calls to themselves.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls involving recursive fixpoints with higher-order self-calls were previously failing, they may now succeed after this fix.

entries.title: Implement a naive termination checker
entries.summary: Implemented a naive termination checker for inductive definitions in EasyCrypt.
entries.repair_hint: Definitions that were previously accepted may now be rejected if they fail the termination check; refactor recursive definitions to be structurally terminating.

entries.title: remove admitted proof in  DJoin
entries.summary: Replaced an admitted proof in the DJoin distribution theory with a proper proof.

entries.title: [theories]: ring with generic (choice based) inverse
entries.summary: Added a ring structure with a generic choice-based inverse to the Ring theory.
entries.repair_hint: The Ring theory now provides a generic inverse via choice; proofs that previously required an explicit inverse construction may use this new structure.

entries.title: Attempt to implement `RingQuotientDflInv`
entries.summary: Added an implementation of RingQuotientDflInv to the Ideal theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving ring quotient structures or Ideal.ec fail, check whether RingQuotientDflInv now provides or changes lemmas you rely on.

entries.title: fix small bug in reduction of projection
entries.summary: Fixed a small bug in the call-by-value reduction of projections.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving record/tuple projection reduction was silently wrong, it may now behave differently after this bug fix.

entries.title: Added cancellation variant for ofword that uses mkseq to Word.eca, and added lemmas about the integer values of onew and zerow to BitWord.eca.
entries.summary: Added a cancellation lemma for ofword using mkseq to Word.eca and added lemmas about integer values of onew and zerow to BitWord.eca.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about word operations, onew, or zerow are failing, check whether the newly added lemmas can be used directly or if existing lemma names have shifted.

entries.title: Unify created variables correctly.
entries.summary: Fixed unification of created variables in the type checker.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that rely on variable unification during cloning or type-checking now fail or succeed differently, this internal fix may be the cause.

entries.title: [tactic]: add the ability to create a memory from thin air.
entries.summary: Added a tactic ability to create a memory from thin air in PHL/PROM goals.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving memory creation in a probabilistic or Hoare context fails, check whether the new memory-introduction tactic is needed or has changed the proof state shape.

entries.title: [tactic]: added hoare variant for `match`
entries.summary: Added a Hoare-logic variant of the match tactic for case-splitting on match expressions.
entries.repair_hint: If a Hoare-style proof over a match expression now fails or requires a different tactic invocation, try the new Hoare match variant.

entries.title: [internal]: fix detection of empty expression-level substitutions.
entries.summary: Fixed detection of empty expression-level substitutions in the type system.

entries.title: remove unused dependency (cmdliner)
entries.summary: Removed unused cmdliner dependency from the build.

entries.title: [runtest]: append scenarios to the CLI
entries.summary: Appended test scenarios to the CLI for the runtest infrastructure.

entries.title: [CLI]: ec-runtest is now accessible via a CLI subcommand
entries.summary: Made ec-runtest accessible as a CLI subcommand rather than a standalone binary.

entries.title: [tactic]: fix t_solve performance issues
entries.summary: Fixed performance issues in the t_solve tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using t_solve (or solve) are timing out or behaving differently, this performance fix may change which goals are closed automatically.

entries.title: operator to get maximal element in list
entries.summary: Added an operator to retrieve the maximal element from a list to List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about list extrema are failing, check whether the new max-element operator or associated lemmas conflict with or can replace existing definitions.

entries.title: Remove dependency to oldlibs for Group
entries.summary: Removed the dependency of Group.ec and related theories on oldlibs, refactoring imports across many algebra and crypto theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs importing Group, ZModP, DiffieHellman, or related theories fail with missing or ambiguous identifiers, update imports to remove oldlibs paths and use the new direct theory references.

entries.title: Various bug fixes for clones (modules & lemmas)
entries.summary: Fixed various bugs in cloning of modules and lemmas.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that clone theories with modules or lemmas now fail or behave differently, these bug fixes may have corrected previously silently-wrong cloning behavior.

entries.title: force delta on convertibility checks
entries.summary: Forced delta unfolding during convertibility checks in theory replay.
entries.repair_hint: If cloned theory proofs now fail because definitions that were previously opaque are now unfolded during convertibility checking, this change is likely the cause; try adding or removing delta hints accordingly.

entries.title: add few lemmas on dfun
entries.summary: Several new lemmas about dfun distributions were added to Distr.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about dfun distributions is missing a lemma, check whether it was added in this version and use it directly.

entries.title: add theory Dfun_sub + backport many lemma from deploy-quantum
entries.summary: A new theory Dfun_sub was added and many lemmas were backported from deploy-quantum into RealSeries, Core, Distr, FinType, and Finite.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about dfun, finite types, or real series are failing, check whether the needed lemmas are now available in Dfun_sub or the updated theories.

entries.title: added lemma assoc_none. (#304)
entries.summary: The lemma assoc_none was added to List.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs to reason about assoc returning None, the lemma assoc_none is now available in List.

entries.title: add lemma mu_dlet_le : mu (dlet d F1) P1 <= mu (dlet d F2) P2
entries.summary: The lemma mu_dlet_le was added to Distr.ec, providing an inequality between measures of dlet distributions.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof requires bounding mu of a dlet expression, the new lemma mu_dlet_le may apply.

entries.title: generalize big_pow lemmas
entries.summary: The big_pow lemmas in Bigalg, Ring, and StdBigop were generalized.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using big_pow lemmas break due to changed type assumptions or signatures, check the updated generalizations in Bigalg and StdBigop.

entries.title: telescoping_sum + sum p^i + sum i*p^i
entries.summary: Lemmas for telescoping sums, sum of p^i, and sum of i*p^i were added to Bigalg and StdBigop.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs to simplify power-series or telescoping summations, check the new lemmas in StdBigop.

entries.title: add cnvC cnv_pow
entries.summary: Lemmas cnvC and cnv_pow about convergence were added to RealSeq.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about convergence of sequences is missing a lemma, check whether cnvC or cnv_pow now covers it.

entries.title: lim (x^n) = 0
entries.summary: A lemma that lim(x^n) = 0 (for |x| < 1) was added to RealExp and RealSeq.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs the limit of a geometric sequence, the relevant lemma is now available in RealExp or RealSeq.

entries.title: [stdlib] limit of a sequence of distributions
entries.summary: Support for limits of sequences of distributions was added to RealSeq and Distr.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involves limits of distribution sequences, check the new infrastructure added to RealSeq and Distr.

entries.title: [stdlib]: extra properties on lim
entries.summary: Extra properties about lim were added to RealSeq.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about sequence limits is missing a lemma, check the newly added lim properties in RealSeq.

entries.title: Fix bug in theory replay for modules.
entries.summary: A bug in theory replay for modules was fixed in the EasyCrypt core.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof involving module theory cloning or replay was silently broken, this bug fix may restore correct behavior.

entries.title: Register for the pretty-printer
entries.summary: Pretty-printer registration was updated in the EasyCrypt core.

entries.title: remove admits in Ideal.ec
entries.summary: Admitted lemmas in Ideal.ec were replaced with proper proofs.

entries.title: port Dexcepted to dresrict and deprecate Dfilter
entries.summary: Dexcepted was ported to use drestrict and Dfilter was deprecated.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof imports or uses Dfilter or Dexcepted lemmas, check whether they have been renamed or redirected to drestrict equivalents.

entries.title: tactic [byupto] add missing restriction in the case of adversary.
entries.summary: The byupto tactic was fixed to add a missing restriction in the adversary case.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using byupto was previously accepted but now fails or produces different goals, the tactic now correctly enforces an adversary restriction that was previously missing.

entries.title: Fix a bug when replaying a removed user reduction rule
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in theory replay when a user-defined reduction rule had been removed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof fails during theory replay involving reduction rules, this bug fix may resolve it after upgrading.

entries.title: [stdlib] bound collisions for ROmap
entries.summary: Added bound collision lemmas for ROmap in the PROM stdlib theory.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof about random oracle maps needs collision bounds, check PROM.ec for newly available lemmas.

entries.title: [stdlib] SmtMap: fsize and fcoll + some lemmas
entries.summary: Added fsize and fcoll definitions and associated lemmas to SmtMap in the stdlib.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about SmtMap require size or collision counting, look for the new fsize and fcoll lemmas in SmtMap.ec.

entries.title: add syntaxic upto tactic (#287)
entries.summary: Added a syntactic upto tactic for pHL/pRHL reasoning.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs use upto-style arguments, the new syntactic upto tactic may be usable or required; check updated syntax in examples/upto_syntaxtic.ec.

entries.title: lossless for equiv
entries.summary: Extended the lossless tactic to handle equiv goals.
entries.repair_hint: If a lossless subgoal arises in an equiv context and was previously unprovable automatically, try applying the lossless tactic.

entries.title: Fix pretty-printing of high-order postfix operators
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of high-order postfix operators in the printer.

entries.title: Add postfix notations.
entries.summary: Added support for postfix notations in EasyCrypt syntax.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses operator notations that changed form, check whether they are now expected to be written in postfix style.

entries.title: Fix pretty-printing of %r
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of the %r (real coercion) notation.

entries.title: [stdlib]: core theory conditional distributions
entries.summary: Added core theory support for conditional distributions in Distr.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about conditional distributions are failing, look for newly added definitions and lemmas in Distr.ec.

entries.title: [conv]: add case for program variables & globals
entries.summary: Added handling of program variables and globals in the convertibility reduction engine.
entries.repair_hint: If conversion or reduction steps involving program variables or globals were failing, this fix may resolve them.

entries.title: [while (phl, >=)]: be more restrictive on the variant delta lower-bound
entries.summary: Made the pHL while (>=) rule more restrictive regarding the variant delta lower-bound.
entries.repair_hint: If a while loop proof using the pHL >= variant rule now fails, verify that the delta lower-bound satisfies the stricter requirements.

entries.title: Allow quotient ring elements to be matrix entries
entries.summary: Extended Ideal.ec to allow quotient ring elements to be used as matrix entries.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving matrices over quotient rings were failing due to missing typeclass instances, this addition may resolve them.

entries.title: [stdlib]: Matrix: coeffs in a comm. ring instead of an ID.
entries.summary: Generalized Matrix.eca so that coefficients only require a commutative ring instead of an integral domain.
entries.repair_hint: If matrix-related proofs fail due to changed typeclass assumptions, check that the ring hypotheses match the new commutative ring requirement rather than an integral domain.

entries.title: [build]: use camlp-streams
entries.summary: Updated the build system to use the camlp-streams library.

entries.title: [breaking] Fix unsound pHL while rule
entries.summary: Fixed an unsound pHL while rule, which is a breaking change affecting existing proofs that relied on the incorrect rule.
entries.repair_hint: If pHL while-loop proofs break after this update, the previously accepted proof was relying on an unsound rule; rework the invariant or variant argument to satisfy the now-correct soundness conditions.

entries.title: In tactic apply[alpha]: instiantiate type-varaibles.
entries.summary: The `apply[alpha]` tactic now instantiates type variables during application.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using `apply[alpha]` fails or behaves differently, check whether type variable instantiation is now happening automatically where it previously was not.

entries.title: Fix MEE-CBC example failing smt call
entries.summary: Fixed a failing `smt` call in the MEE-CBC example by adjusting Ring.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls in ring-related goals fail, check whether Ring.ec has new or changed lemmas that should be used as hints.

entries.title: Remove unused PF-WP
entries.summary: Removed the unused PF-WP construct from the parser and type checker.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses PF-WP syntax, it will no longer parse; remove or replace those tactics.

entries.title: Lemmas on dprod and djoin
entries.summary: New lemmas about `dprod` and `djoin` were added to Distr.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about product or join distributions were previously stuck, try using the newly added lemmas from Distr.ec.

entries.title: In `cloning ... with lemma...`, disable inference for `apply`
entries.summary: When cloning with a `lemma` override, type inference for `apply` is now disabled.
entries.repair_hint: If a cloning proof that uses `apply` inside `with lemma` starts failing, explicit type annotations may now be required since inference is disabled in that context.

entries.title: Distinction between modules & module types path in the hi-level subst.
entries.summary: Internal refactor to distinguish between module paths and module type paths in the high-level substitution layer.

entries.title: Relate dbiased and dmap
entries.summary: New lemmas relating `dbiased` and `dmap` were added to DBool.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving `dbiased` are stuck, check for new lemmas in DBool.ec connecting it to `dmap`.

entries.title: Add a warning for useless delta-unfolding
entries.summary: A warning is now emitted when a delta-unfolding step is useless (no actual unfolding occurs), and many library files were updated to remove such useless unfoldings.
entries.repair_hint: If proof scripts produce new warnings about useless delta-unfolding, remove or replace the offending `delta` hints; they were no-ops and the goal should still close without them.

entries.title: When replaying a reduction rule, check that the rule does still exists.
entries.summary: Theory replay now checks that a reduction rule still exists before replaying it, raising an error if it does not.
entries.repair_hint: If theory cloning or replay fails with an error about a missing reduction rule, the rule may have been removed or renamed in the base theory.

entries.title: Enforce section restrictions on the types of declared modules.
entries.summary: Section checking now enforces restrictions on the types of modules declared within a section.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof that uses sections fails with a new type-checking or restriction error on module declarations, revise the module types to comply with the stricter section rules.

entries.title: Fix a typing annotation bug in distribution tags' axioms
entries.summary: Fixed a typing annotation bug in the axioms generated for distribution tags.

entries.title: Fix unprecise/invalid error message
entries.summary: Corrected an imprecise or invalid error message in ecScope.

entries.title: [theories]: Add scalar-vector multiplication
entries.summary: Scalar-vector multiplication was added to the Matrix theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about matrix/vector arithmetic were previously incomplete, check for new scalar-vector multiplication lemmas in Matrix.eca.

entries.title: theories: add back "oldlibs" in the CI + fix
entries.summary: The `oldlibs` directory was re-added to the CI test suite with fixes to several legacy library files.

entries.title: add looptransform
entries.summary: A new LoopTransform theory was added to support loop transformation reasoning.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs require loop transformation lemmas, the new LoopTransform.ec theory may provide the needed tools.

entries.title: slightly reduce reliance on trivial SMT calls
entries.summary: Reduced reliance on trivial SMT calls in core and crypto theories.

entries.title: unify meaning of `by []`
entries.summary: Unified the meaning of `by []` across the system and updated affected theories.
entries.repair_hint: If `by []` previously closed a goal but no longer does, try replacing it with `by done`, `by smt()`, or an explicit tactic sequence.

entries.title: strip out code related to proc *
entries.summary: Removed internal code supporting the `proc *` construct from the core modules and proof machinery.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs used `proc *` syntax in module signatures or procedure calls, they will break; replace with explicit procedure names.

entries.title: Remove parser support for `proc *` in module sigs
entries.summary: Removed parser support for `proc *` in module signatures, updating examples and crypto theories accordingly.
entries.repair_hint: Replace any use of `proc *` in module signature declarations with explicit procedure listings.

entries.title: Hakyber jasmin eclib
entries.summary: Extended and updated several algebra, analysis, and datatype theories for HaKyber/Jasmin EcLib compatibility.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs over algebra or datatype theories break, check whether lemma names or statement forms have changed in IntDiv, Ring, List, or related theories.

entries.title: Fix ordering of variables in `rndsem`
entries.summary: Fixed the ordering of variables produced by the `rndsem` tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `rndsem` fail or generate goals with differently-ordered variables, adjust subsequent variable references or intro patterns accordingly.

entries.title: Fix naming issue for the [#] intro-pattern
entries.summary: Fixed a naming issue with the `[#]` intro-pattern that caused incorrect hypothesis names.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs relying on names generated by the `[#]` intro-pattern break, check that hypothesis names match the corrected naming behavior.

entries.title: Dependent version of the multi-rnd tactic
entries.summary: Added a dependent version of the multi-rnd tactic and updated DProd theory accordingly.
entries.repair_hint: If multi-sampling `rnd` proofs break, check whether the new dependent form requires updated arguments or a different invocation syntax.

entries.title: Extend `rnd` tactic s.t. it can handle multiple samplings / assignments
entries.summary: Extended the `rnd` tactic to handle multiple samplings and assignments in a single step.
entries.repair_hint: If `rnd` proofs break or behave differently, check whether the tactic now consumes more sampling steps than before and adjust the proof structure accordingly.

entries.title: remove "rnd := f" syntax
entries.summary: Removed the `rnd := f` syntax from the parser.
entries.repair_hint: Replace any use of `rnd := f` with the current supported `rnd` tactic syntax.

entries.title: Switched from x <> y being expanded by the parser to ! (x = y), and consequently having several explicit parsing rules (including one involving using it as a constructor in a match, which was buggy) to removing the special parsing treatment and adding it as an abbreviation.
entries.summary: Changed `x <> y` from a parser-expanded form of `! (x = y)` to a proper abbreviation, removing special-case parsing rules.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs matching on or destructing `<>` break, note that it is now an abbreviation for `! (x = y)` and adjust pattern matches or rewrites accordingly.

entries.title: In loop fusion/fission, add more constraints on the epilog
entries.summary: Added stricter constraints on the epilogue in loop fusion and fission tactics.
entries.repair_hint: If loop fusion or fission tactic invocations fail, check whether the epilogue of the loop now violates the new constraints and restructure accordingly.

entries.title: Add an option that allows EasyCrypt to connect to an external Why3 server
entries.summary: Added a command-line option allowing EasyCrypt to connect to an external Why3 server.

entries.title: Clear the blocked signals mask on startup.
entries.summary: EasyCrypt now clears the blocked signals mask on startup.

entries.title: new command: exit (stops EasyCrypt)
entries.summary: Added a new `exit` command that stops the EasyCrypt process.

entries.title: smt option to dump a smt query to a file
entries.summary: Added an SMT option to dump the SMT query to a file for debugging purposes.

entries.title: Fix pretty-printing of projections.
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of projections in the EasyCrypt printer.

entries.title: mark `transpose` as parse-only
entries.summary: The `transpose` operator was marked as parse-only in Logic.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses `transpose` in a non-parse context (e.g., directly in a lemma statement or rewrite), it may now fail; check whether `transpose` is being used in a supported context.

entries.title: [stdlib]: more lemmas around dfun.
entries.summary: Additional lemmas about `dfun` were added to the Distr.ec standard library.

entries.title: [stdlib] new lemmas around dscalar & dlet.
entries.summary: New lemmas about `dscalar` and `dlet` were added to the Distr.ec standard library.

entries.title: [stdlib]: new operator for updating a function at one point.
entries.summary: A new operator for updating a function at a single point was added to Logic.ec.

entries.title: New `runtest` script
entries.summary: A new `runtest` script was added for running EasyCrypt tests.

entries.title: Fix pretty-printing of mixfix notations.
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of mixfix notations in the EasyCrypt printer.

entries.title: When configuring Why3, create the configuration file destination directory first
entries.summary: The Why3 configuration step now creates the destination directory before writing the configuration file.

entries.title: [stdlib]: link Finite & FinType.
entries.summary: The `Finite` and `FinType` theories were linked together in FinType.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof imports or relies on `FinType` or `Finite` separately, check whether the new linking introduces name conflicts or changes what is in scope.

entries.title: error on potential procedure call in RHS of <-
entries.summary: EasyCrypt now raises an error when a potential procedure call appears on the right-hand side of a `<-` assignment.
entries.repair_hint: If an existing proof script uses `<-` where a procedure call should use `<@`, it will now produce a type error; replace `<-` with `<@` for procedure calls.

entries.title: Enforce separation between <- and <@ more strictly
entries.summary: The separation between the `<-` (assignment) and `<@` (procedure call) syntax is now enforced more strictly.
entries.repair_hint: Proof scripts mixing up `<-` and `<@` will now fail; ensure procedure calls use `<@` and simple assignments use `<-`.

entries.title: [stdlib]: add various small lemmas (Logic, FSet, Distr, DInterval, Bigop)
entries.summary: Various small lemmas were added to Logic, FSet, Distr, DInterval, and Bigop standard library theories.

entries.title: Change configuration file resolution
entries.summary: Changed how EasyCrypt resolves its configuration file.

entries.title: Finite.to_seq: now have a body based on choiceb
entries.summary: `Finite.to_seq` now has a concrete body defined in terms of `choiceb` rather than being abstract.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs that relied on `to_seq` being opaque or abstract may need to be updated now that it has a concrete definition via `choiceb`.

entries.title: Use local configuration file in priority
entries.summary: Local configuration files are now given priority over global ones during EasyCrypt startup.

entries.title: Fic computation of source root for local builds
entries.summary: Fixed computation of the source root path for local builds in the relocation module.

entries.title: New tactic: `outline` (#473)
entries.summary: A new tactic `outline` has been added for PHL proof goals.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses `outline`, ensure the EasyCrypt version supports it; if missing, this tactic did not exist in earlier versions.

entries.title: New command prefix: `fail`
entries.summary: A new command prefix `fail` has been added to the EasyCrypt language.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses `fail` as a command prefix and fails to parse, check whether the EasyCrypt version supports this prefix.

entries.title: extend weakmem to hoare/choare/ehoare/equiv
entries.summary: The `weakmem` tactic has been extended to support hoare, choare, ehoare, and equiv judgements in addition to its previous scope.
entries.repair_hint: If `weakmem` fails on a hoare/choare/ehoare/equiv goal, check that the EasyCrypt version is new enough to support these judgement forms.

entries.title: Fix reduction w.r.t. memory types.
entries.summary: A bug in reduction with respect to memory types has been fixed.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof that previously relied on incorrect reduction behaviour around memory types now fails, inspect goals involving memory type reduction and try adjusting reduction strategies.

entries.title: Add tactic `weakmem`
entries.summary: A new tactic `weakmem` has been added for weakening memory in program logic goals.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses `weakmem` and it is not recognised, the EasyCrypt version predates this tactic's introduction.

entries.title: rndsem: new version that only computes the distribution for used variables
entries.summary: The `rndsem` tactic has been updated to compute distributions only for variables that are actually used, changing its behaviour.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using `rndsem` break, the tactic now produces a more refined distribution computation; goals or intermediate results may differ and require adjustment.

entries.title: In substitutions, lazyly refresh the codomain of the univar map
entries.summary: Substitutions now lazily refresh the codomain of the univar map as an internal performance/correctness improvement.

entries.title: In view application, close cut formula after substitution
entries.summary: In view application, the cut formula is now closed after substitution, fixing a bug in proof term handling.
entries.repair_hint: If view applications (`apply`) behave differently or proofs using views break, the change in when the cut formula is closed may affect goal shapes; re-examine the resulting goals.

entries.title: Compile in `dev` mode by default.
entries.summary: The build system now compiles EasyCrypt in `dev` mode by default.

entries.title: runtest: new option: why3 (why3 configuration file location)
runtest: allows to specify provers from the CLI
Allows selecting a prover by its version number.
entries.summary: Users can now select an SMT prover by specifying its version number.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls fail due to prover selection, check whether prover version syntax in `pragma` or configuration is now required/changed.

entries.title: Removed two unused type declarations.
entries.summary: Two unused type declarations have been removed from internal modules.

entries.title: Share the definition of the datatypes in EcAst.ml
entries.summary: Datatype definitions have been consolidated into a shared `EcAst.ml` module across the codebase.

entries.title: SMT timeout can now be configured in INI files
entries.summary: The SMT timeout can now be set in INI configuration files.

entries.title: Support project-local ini files
entries.summary: EasyCrypt now supports project-local INI configuration files.

entries.title: When rewriting in the local env, do not fail on identity rewriting
entries.summary: When rewriting in the local environment, identity rewrites (where nothing changes) no longer cause a failure.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof previously relied on `rewrite` failing when the rewrite is an identity, this behaviour has changed; proofs that used `try rewrite` or caught failure may behave differently.

entries.title: ehoare
entries.summary: A new eHoare logic judgment and associated tactics/infrastructure were added to EasyCrypt, touching the parser, typechecker, PHL tactic modules, and core formula representations.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving hoare/phl tactics break, check whether new ehoare-related syntax or judgment forms conflict with existing goal shapes; also check if changes to ecCoreFol or ecFol altered formula constructors used in proof scripts.

entries.title: Nits: choiceb induction principle
entries.summary: Minor fixes or additions related to the choiceb induction principle across several theory files.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using choiceb or related induction principles fail, check whether the induction principle's statement or name has been adjusted in Core.ec or the affected theory files.

entries.title: remove some edgy SMTs in Xreal and related
entries.summary: Removed some SMT-backed lemmas in Xreal and related theories.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs relying on SMT calls in Xreal break, check whether the removed lemmas were being used and replace with explicit proofs or alternative lemmas.

entries.title: minor: remove debugging output
entries.summary: Removed debugging output from ecLowGoal.

entries.title: stage the SmtMap -> FMap renaming
entries.summary: The SmtMap theory is being renamed to FMap.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs import or reference SmtMap, replace with FMap.

entries.title: Simple tactics in proof-terms.
entries.summary: Simple tactics are now supported inside proof-terms.
entries.repair_hint: If proof-term style proofs fail, check whether newly supported simple tactics inside proof-terms can be used to fix them.

entries.title: Tactic to call Coq (interactively or not) on goals via Why3.
entries.summary: A new tactic was added to call Coq (interactively or not) on goals via Why3.
entries.repair_hint: If a goal cannot be solved by smt, try the new coq tactic as an alternative.

entries.title: internal: handle CTRL+C properly w.r.t. Why3 server
pretty printer: better handling of long module paths
entries.summary: Improved pretty-printer handling of long module paths.

entries.title: Change default pp width from 20 to 80
entries.summary: Changed the default pretty-printer width from 20 to 80 characters.

entries.title: Optimization hack for checking operator compatibility in clones
entries.summary: Added an optimization hack for checking operator compatibility during clone elaboration.

entries.title: More results on lists (take/drop) and bit-encoding (bs2int/chunk)
entries.summary: Added more lemmas on list take/drop and bit-encoding bs2int/chunk operations.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about take/drop or bs2int/chunk were previously blocked, check if the new lemmas in BitEncoding or List can close those goals.

entries.title: [smt]: proper selection of SMT variant
entries.summary: Fixed proper selection of the SMT variant when invoking the smt tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If smt calls behave differently or fail, check SMT prover configuration and variant selection.

entries.title: [stdlib]: more lemmas on distributions over lists
entries.summary: Added more lemmas on distributions over lists in DList.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about DList distributions are failing, check whether the newly added lemmas can be applied.

entries.title: [stdlib]: extra lemmas on dprod.
entries.summary: Added extra lemmas on dprod in the Distr theory.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about dprod are failing, check whether the newly added lemmas in Distr cover the needed properties.

entries.title: new vernacular: print axiom
entries.summary: Added a new 'print axiom' vernacular command.

entries.title: [stdlib]: remove axioms (int + inductive schemes)
entries.summary: Removed some axioms related to integers and inductive schemes from the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that depended on those axioms in Int or List break, look for replacement lemmas or provide explicit proofs for previously axiomatized facts.

entries.title: [stdlib]: List: more lemmas on insert and related
entries.summary: Added more lemmas on list insertion and related operations in List.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs about list insertion are failing, check whether the newly added lemmas in List can be applied.

entries.title: Fixing bug in elim* when a bound is given.
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in the `elim*` tactic when a bound is explicitly provided.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using `elim*` with a numeric bound was previously broken, try it again as the bug has been fixed.

entries.title: [stdlib]: iftrue / iffalse
entries.summary: Added `iftrue` and `iffalse` lemmas to the `Logic` theory in the standard library.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof needs lemmas about conditional expressions reducing under known boolean values, try using `iftrue` or `iffalse` from `Logic`.

entries.title: Fix spacing issues in pretty-printer
entries.summary: Fixed spacing issues in the pretty-printer output.

entries.title: New tags for operators: smt_opaque
entries.summary: Introduced a new `smt_opaque` tag for operators to control their visibility to the SMT backend.
entries.repair_hint: If SMT calls fail or behave differently on operators that were previously transparent, check whether they have been tagged `smt_opaque` and adjust hints or unfolding accordingly.

entries.title: Remove the "nosmt" mechanism
entries.summary: Removed the `nosmt` annotation mechanism entirely from EasyCrypt and the standard library theories.
entries.repair_hint: Remove any `nosmt` annotations from operator or lemma declarations; they are no longer valid syntax and will cause parse errors.

entries.title: make dapply a parsing-only abbreviation
entries.summary: Made `dapply` a parsing-level abbreviation rather than a standalone tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If `dapply` is used in a proof script and fails, check whether the expansion of the abbreviation is still compatible with the surrounding proof context.

entries.title: [internal]: fix filtering as saved theory-related environments
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in filtering of saved theory-related environments.

entries.title: [pretty-printing]: pretty-print in the theory environment of the target object
entries.summary: Changed the pretty-printer to use the theory environment of the target object when displaying terms.

entries.title: simplify representation of memory restriction (#569)
entries.summary: Simplified the internal representation of memory restrictions.

entries.title: [internal]: make public some functions needed by external projects
entries.summary: Made some internal functions in `ecCommands` and `ecScope` public for use by external projects.

entries.title: [pretty-printing]: fix construction application display in match patterns
entries.summary: Fixed pretty-printing of constructor application display inside match patterns.

entries.title: Simplify/clean up memory/call restrictions.
entries.summary: Simplified and cleaned up the internal representation of memory and call restrictions.

entries.title: proc change/rewrite: can be applied to if/while/match conditions/targets
entries.summary: Extended `proc change` and `proc rewrite` to be applicable to conditions/targets of `if`, `while`, and `match` statements.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script uses `proc change` or `proc rewrite` on if/while/match sub-expressions, this should now work where it previously failed.

entries.title: Reduce equalities between record literals.
entries.summary: The reduction engine now reduces equalities between record literals.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof relies on manual unfolding or rewriting of record literal equalities, it may now be dischargeable automatically by reduction/simplification tactics.

entries.title: (undocumented) option to pass EC arguments via runtest
entries.summary: Added an undocumented option to pass EasyCrypt arguments via the runtest framework.

entries.title: (undocumented) option that runs the GC compaction every `n` commands
entries.summary: Added an undocumented option to run GC compaction every n commands.

entries.title: Do not compute GC stats twice when printing memory statistics
entries.summary: Fixed a bug that computed GC statistics twice when printing memory statistics.

entries.title: Remove non-strict proof mode.
entries.summary: The non-strict proof mode has been removed from EasyCrypt.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof script relied on non-strict proof mode (e.g. leaving subgoals open without error), it will now fail; rewrite the proof to close all goals strictly.

entries.title: Change `axiom eq_choice` to lemma
entries.summary: The declaration `eq_choice` was changed from an axiom to a lemma in Logic.ec.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof depended on `eq_choice` being an axiom (e.g. for foundational reasons), it should still work as a lemma; no script-level repair is likely needed, but check if any `axiom` keyword references it explicitly.

entries.title: runtest: all to control the number of files checked in parallel
[subst]: fix name capture
entries.summary: Fixed a name-capture bug in the `subst` tactic.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof using `subst` was silently producing wrong results due to name capture, it may now behave differently; review proofs that use `subst` where variable names could clash.

entries.title: tactic: match: out of TCB
entries.summary: The `match` tactic was moved out of the trusted computing base (TCB) into a derived layer.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs using the `match` tactic break, the tactic's internal proof obligations may now be exposed differently; inspect any failing `match` steps for new subgoals.

entries.title: Fix HO matching
entries.summary: Fixed a bug in higher-order matching used during proof term elaboration.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs that rely on higher-order pattern matching (e.g. via `apply` or `rewrite` with HO patterns) now fail or succeed differently, the fix may have changed which terms are matched; adjust patterns accordingly.

entries.title: stdlib: bigop: split sums between even- and odd- indices
entries.summary: Added lemmas to Bigop.eca for splitting sums between even- and odd-indexed terms.

entries.title: Allow patterns in cut-rewrite.
entries.summary: The cut-rewrite tactic now allows patterns to be specified.
entries.repair_hint: If a proof uses cut-rewrite and the new pattern syntax conflicts with existing syntax, update the tactic invocation to match the new grammar.

entries.title: New tactic: "proc rewrite"
entries.summary: A new tactic `proc rewrite` has been added for rewriting inside procedure bodies.

entries.title: Internal change: primitive notion of forall-bindings in proof terms
runtest: accept all options from the prover/loader group
New tactic: "proc change"
entries.summary: A new tactic `proc change` has been added for changing procedure code in PHL goals.

entries.title: DigitalSignatures.eca library
entries.summary: New library files DigitalSignatures.eca and DigitalSignaturesROM.eca were added to the crypto theories.

entries.title: This diff removes the cost logic.

entries.title: Propagate extended code positions to more tactics

entries.body_excerpt:
Nearly all program tactics (`wp`, `sp`, ...) can now take extended

entries.title: The tactic `swap` now takes generalized code position.
entries.summary: The `swap` tactic now accepts generalized code positions, which is a breaking change to its syntax.
entries.repair_hint: If swap invocations break, update the code position arguments to use the new generalized position syntax expected by swap.
entries.body_excerpt:
Moreover, offsets can bow be absolute (i.e. can be a code-position). In that case, the meaning is "move the code block before the targetted instruction".
    
This work brings some breaking changes:
    
- the variant `swap i1 i2 i3` has been removed. It was a way to give a direct access to the low-level functionality, but its interface is brittle and is not used by any development
    
- a bug has been found in the resolution of negative code position (they were all shifted by one, making impossible to target the last instruction). This now has been fixed.

When the lexer identifies a decimal number, but the parser is in a state where a decimal number isn't accepted, it returns the a number-dot-number token sequence instead.

entries.title: Better operators overloading inference

entries.repair_hint: If overloaded operators are now resolved differently (e.g., a previously ambiguous operator now picks a different instance), add explicit type annotations or operator qualifications to disambiguate.
entries.body_excerpt:
This PR is about using more type information to resolve the overloading of operators. Currently, the following is now accepted:

```
require import AllCore List.

theory T.
  op o : int.
  op a : int -> int -> int.
end T.

theory U.
  op o : bool.
  op a : bool -> bool -> bool.
end U.

import T U.

op foo : int -> unit.

op bar = foo o.

op plop1 = foldr a false [].

op plop2 = foldr (fun x => a x) false [].

op plop3 = foldr (fun x y => a x y) false [].
```

is translated into

entries.title: Making program logic formulas memory-agnostic
entries.summary: Program logic formulas were made memory-agnostic, changing how memories are represented and handled throughout the PHL infrastructure.
entries.repair_hint: Proofs using program logic judgments (hoare, equiv, bdhoare, phoare) may break due to changes in how memory arguments are encoded in formulas; check if memory variables or memory-indexed expressions need to be updated in goal statements and tactic arguments.
entries.body_excerpt:
Rather than program logic formulas hardcoding `mhr` as the bound memory in single sided formulas and `mleft` and `mright` as the bound memories in two sided formulas we make the formulas carry along the bound memor(y/ies).

The end goal is to allow things like nested hoare statements.

Re-do of #762

The number of touched files in the PR is causing significant slowdown in the GitHub web-interface on my end, so if this happens to anyone else just waiting half a minute seems to work.

entries.title: Expose memory binding(s) in program logic statements

entries.repair_hint: If proof scripts writing or parsing program logic statements (hoare, equiv, etc.) fail to parse, check whether explicit memory binding syntax is now required or has changed form.
entries.body_excerpt:
This is a follow up PR to #789 that now allows the user to decide the name of the memory bound by a program logic statement or probability expression. This makes nested program logic statements clearer.

The syntax is `{&my_memory}` after the procedures (and arguments for a Pr) (for the relevant side if two-sided).
Examples:
 - `hoare[P.p {&m}: true ==> true]`
 - `Pr[P.p(a) {&end_mem} @ &start_mem: true] = 0%r`
 - `equiv[P.p {&left} ~ P.p {&right}: true ==> true]`

The change is backwards compatible since it is optional to provide the memory. If not provided a default name will be used

  | Leaf of 'a
  | Children of 'a tree list

This PR changes the positivity check algorithm and allows such definition. Before, the following would fail:
```

module M = {var x: bool proc p()={}}.

```

proof. move => ->>. (* This fails to substitute *)
```

entries.title: In clone, allow applying renamings pre-emptively
entries.summary: The `clone` command now allows renamings to be applied pre-emptively before the cloning is finalized.
entries.repair_hint: If a clone command behaves unexpectedly, check whether pre-emptive renamings are being applied and adjust renaming order accordingly.
entries.body_excerpt:
When cloning a theory and subtituting a sub-theory by some other one, it is now possible to apply renamings on the target sub-theory.

The syntax is:

```
clone T ... with theory T <- U { rename ... }
```

This allows to substitute one theory by some other one that got some of its components renamed by a
previous clone.

For example:

```
abstract theory Word.
  op foo_XX = ...
end Word.

clone Word as W16 rename "_XX" as "_16".

abstract theory UseWord.
  clone Word as W.
end UseWord.

clone UseWord as UseWord16 with
  theory W <- W16 { rename "_XX" as "_16" }.
```

## Summary

- Add a new `simplify if` tactic that performs if-conversion on program

  the weakest precondition becomes linear in the size of the program.
- The tactic preserves program semantics and can be applied to all
  program logics (hoare, bdhoare, ehoare).

way and is picked up by `scripts/testing/runtest`.

entries.title: congr: add `congr pat` and `congr *` variants
entries.summary: The `congr` tactic gained `congr pat` and `congr *` variants for pattern-directed and exhaustive congruence.
entries.repair_hint: Existing uses of plain `congr` should be unaffected; if goals involving congruence now behave differently, try the new `congr *` variant.
entries.body_excerpt:
\`congr pat\` requires the pattern to match both sides of the goal
equality (or iff); each pattern variable yields one subgoal equating
its bindings on the two sides. \`congr *\` walks both sides in lock-step
without any reduction, emitting one subgoal per pair of differing
positions. Both variants are first-order (binders are opaque, matching
the existing \`congr\`'s behavior).

entries.title: feat: named ring/field instances for `ring`/`field` structure selection
entries.summary: The `ring` and `field` tactics now support named ring/field instances for explicit structure selection.
entries.repair_hint: If `ring` or `field` tactics fail where multiple instances exist, try specifying the instance by name using the new named instance syntax.
entries.body_excerpt:
A carrier type can carry several ring/field structures; the tactics
silently used the first registered one with no way to disambiguate.

Give instances an optional name at declaration:

```
instance ring [foo] with T ...
```

and let the tactic target it:

```
ring [foo] / field [foo]
```

Bare `ring`/`field` are unchanged: with no name, the first matching
instance is used, so the single-structure case behaves identically.

entries.title: fix(quotient): keep repr/pi opaque to SMT
entries.summary: The `repr` and `pi` functions in the Quotient theory are now kept opaque to the SMT solver.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs relying on SMT discharging goals involving `repr` or `pi` from Quotient break, those goals may now need to be handled manually or with explicit unfolding.
entries.body_excerpt:
The CanonQuotient rewrite made `repr`/`pi` transparent, exposing the
subtype (val/insubd) projections and the function-valued `canon` to the
SMT backend. On large goals this bloats the emitted problem and defeats
the solvers, failing to close goals that previously discharged.

Mark `repr`/`pi` as [smt_opaque], defined at their real site so opacity
survives the clone `subst`, so consumers see the clean quotient interface
(reprK, piK, ...) instead of the subtype encoding.

entries.title: perf: relax OCaml 5.x GC pacing for custom blocks, warn on 5.0–5.3
entries.summary: OCaml 5.x GC pacing for custom blocks was relaxed and a warning for OCaml 5.0–5.3 was added.
entries.body_excerpt:
EasyCrypt hash-conses its AST and allocates zarith/GMP custom blocks heavily. On OCaml 5.x the default custom_major_ratio paces the major GC far too aggressively over that external memory (OCaml issue #14533, pronounced on 5.5), costing large amounts of CPU for no memory benefit: compiling a large file (NTTAlgebra.ec) measured ~5x slower than on 4.14 (1255s vs 339s), with the same ~1GB working set.

Set custom_major_ratio to 250 on OCaml >= 5, which restores 4.14-class performance (5.5: 1255s -> 233s). This is a no-op on 5.4, whose default pacing is already fine, and harmless there.

entries.title: Make proof-local simplify hint databases visible to conversion
entries.summary: Proof-local simplify hint databases are now visible to the conversion mechanism used during type-checking and tactics.
entries.repair_hint: If proofs involving conversion or unification now close goals they previously did not (or vice versa), it may be because local simplify hints are now applied during conversion.
entries.body_excerpt:
The named/local hint-database mechanism records the set of active
databases per goal (g_simpl), but several tactics consulted user
reduction rules through static reduction_info values (full_compat /
full_red with an empty user_local), so rules activated with
`hint +db.` were invisible to them.

With this, `hint simplify in db : ...` + a proof-local `hint +db.`
behaves exactly like the former global default-database hints.
